The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB), also known as RSMSSB, has released the result-related documents for Platoon Commander Direct Recruitment 2025 (Advt No. 05/2025) on 17 July 2026. Three separate documents were published on the same date: the provisionally qualified candidate lists after interview for both the TSP and Non-TSP areas, and the meritwise list of selected candidates with cut off marks after interview. Candidates who appeared in the written exam, PET/PST, and interview stages can check their status using the official links below.

How to Check RSSB Platoon Commander Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RSSB website at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in.

This article does not display specific numeric cut off figures because they could not be independently verified from an accessible source at the time of writing candidates must check the official PDF directly.

The Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC) has released the Final Select List 2026 for the post of Veterinary Officer under the Animal Husbandry and Fisheries Department. The list was notified vide Notification No. PSC 1 RTB-01/2024, dated 17-07-2026, and covers candidates recommended for appointment against the Residual Parent Cadre (Backlog) and Residual Parent Cadre (General) categories of the 342+58 Veterinary Officer posts advertised earlier.

This article explains the background of the recruitment, the final select list details, category-wise cutoff marks, top-ranked candidates, and how to download the official PDF.

Official Website kpsc.kar.nic.in

KPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment: Background

KPSC had earlier issued Notification No. PSC 1 RTB-01/2024 dated 29-07-2024 inviting applications for 342 regular posts plus 58 backlog posts of Veterinary Officer (total 400 posts) under the Animal Husbandry and Fisheries Department. The provisional select list for these posts was published on 26-05-2026 as per the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 2021, and its amendment rules, and candidates were given 7 days to submit objections.

After examining the objections received within the stipulated period, KPSC has now published the final select list of eligible candidates recommended for appointment as Veterinary Officer.

Important Dates

  • Original Notification Issued: 29-07-2024
  • Provisional Select List Published: 26-05-2026
  • Last Date to Raise Objections: Within 7 days of provisional list
  • Final Select List Published: 17-07-2026

KPSC Veterinary Officer Vacancy Details

The recruitment covered 400 Veterinary Officer posts, split across two cadre categories as reflected in the final select list:

Category of List Number of Selected Candidates Qualification Required
Residual Parent Cadre (Backlog) 56 BVSc and AH
Residual Parent Cadre (General) 273 BVSc and AH
Total Selected 329 -

Note: Age limit, pay scale/salary, and application fee details are not mentioned in this final select list notification. These details were part of the original 2024 recruitment notification. If you need them, please refer to the original KPSC Veterinary Officer notification dated 29-07-2024.

Selection Process

Selection for the post of Veterinary Officer was made by KPSC based on the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 2021, and the amendment rules. The process followed was:

  1. Publication of the original recruitment notification (29-07-2024)
  2. Receipt and scrutiny of applications
  3. Preparation and publication of the provisional select list (26-05-2026)
  4. Receipt of objections from candidates within 7 days
  5. Scrutiny of objections received within the timeframe
  6. Publication of the final select list (17-07-2026)

The final select list is based on the Extended Total Marks (EXTOTMK) and the corresponding Total Percentage (TPERS) secured by each candidate, arranged category-wise in descending order of merit.

The Electronics and Radar Development Establishment (LRDE), a laboratory of the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence, Government of India, has released the provisional result for the LRDE Paid Internship 2026-27. The notification was published on 16 July 2026 and lists candidates provisionally selected, along with a waitlist, for a six-month paid internship at LRDE, Bengaluru.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

This article covers the complete selected and waitlisted candidates list, important dates, stipend details, required documents, and the exact steps candidates must follow next, based strictly on the official notification.

DRDO LRDE Result 2026 - Overview

Particular Details
Organisation Electronics and Radar Development Establishment (LRDE), DRDO
Notification Title Provisional List of Selected Candidates - LRDE Paid Internship 2026-27
Location CV Raman Nagar, Bengaluru - 560093
Result Published On 16 July 2026
Total Provisionally Selected 75 candidates
Total Waitlisted 48 candidates
Internship Duration 6 months
Stipend ₹5,000 per month
Internship Start Date 3 August 2026
Willingness Submission Deadline 24 July 2026
Document Verification / Reporting Date 31 July 2026

Important Dates

  • Published Date of Result: 16 July 2026
  • Last Date to Submit Willingness Email: 24 July 2026
  • Reporting Date for Document Verification: 31 July 2026
  • Internship Start Date: 3 August 2026
  • Notification Validity Window (as listed on DRDO website): 16 July 2026 to 31 July 2026

DRDO LRDE Internship Stipend

  • Stipend: ₹5,000 per month for the six-month internship period.
  • Paid in two equal instalments of ₹15,000 each - one after successful completion of 3 months, and the second after successful completion of 6 months.
  • No stipend is payable for an internship period of less than six months.
  • No other allowance or reimbursement (such as lodging, boarding, transport, or medical expenses) will be paid; these must be borne by the intern.

Required Documents for Verification

Provisionally selected candidates must carry the following in original, plus one set of self-attested photocopies, on the reporting date:

  • 10th standard mark sheet
  • Mark sheets of the qualifying examination for all semesters/years, as applicable (if CGPA is used, the university's official CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula document is also required)
  • Photo ID card issued by the State Government or Government of India (Aadhaar card preferred)
  • College ID card
  • Four recent photographs (2 stamp size and 2 passport size)
  • Police verification report from the respective district/local police station
  • Aadhaar-seeded savings bank account number, with a copy of the first page of the bank passbook/statement

How to Apply Next Steps for Selected Candidates

Since this is a result notification, there is no fresh "apply" step. Provisionally selected candidates must instead complete the following:

  1. Send a willingness email to [email protected] on or before 24 July 2026. If no willingness is received by this date, the candidature will be cancelled and the seat offered to a waitlisted candidate. No further correspondence on this will be entertained.
  2. Report in person to the Director, LRDE, DRDO, CV Raman Nagar, Bengaluru - 560093 on 31 July 2026 for document verification, carrying all required original documents and self-attested copies.
  3. On successful verification, the internship will commence from 3 August 2026.

Important Instructions

  • The internship duration is 6 months and is considered part of the candidate's degree course.
  • Interns must be physically present at LRDE for a minimum of 15 working days per month during the internship.
  • If a candidate who has submitted willingness fails to join on the specified date, the offer will be treated as automatically cancelled with no further intimation.
  • Unfilled seats will be filled from the waitlisted candidates, who should be ready to report on short notice.
  • Interns will only be granted access to non-classified areas within LRDE.
  • Completion of the internship does not guarantee employment at DRDO.

UP Police Constable Expected Cutoff Trends 2026 (Out of 300 Marks)

The written exam is scored out of 300 marks. Cutoff marks are the minimum score a candidate needs to be shortlisted for the next stage Document Verification (DV) and Physical Standard Test (PST). Ground-level analysis shows that cutoff percentages have been shifting upward year on year due to intense preparation levels and high competition among candidates. The category-wise figures below are expected/estimated safe-score trends only they are not the official cutoff, which will be released by UPPRPB along with the result.

Candidate Category Expected Safe Target Score (Out of 300) Approx. Correct Questions

Note: These figures are unofficial estimates based on trend analysis and should be used only as a rough benchmark. The final, official cutoff will depend on factors such as the overall difficulty level of the exam, total number of candidates who appeared, and category-wise vacancy distribution, and will be announced by UPPRPB only at the time of the official result.

Selection Process After the Written Exam Result

Candidates who clear the written exam cutoff will move to the next stages of the UP Police Constable selection process:

  • Document Verification (DV)
  • Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
  • Medical Examination

Exact schedules for these stages are Not Available Officially and will be released by UPPRPB after the written exam result is declared.

  4. Enter your Registration Number / Roll Number and Date of Birth as asked.
  5. Submit the details to view your result and scorecard.
  6. Download and save a copy of your result for future reference.

PPSC PCS Mains Result 2026 - Latest Official Update

According to the public notice dated 15 July 2026, the Punjab Public Service Commission has confirmed that it is committed to ensuring quality, fairness, and uniformity in the evaluation of PSCSCCE 2025 Mains answer sheets. The Commission stated that the number of candidates who appeared in this year's Mains examination is approximately four to five times higher than in previous Mains examinations, which has a direct bearing on how long the evaluation takes.

The notice further states that the evaluation process is being carried out with the utmost care while maintaining uniform standards across all answer sheets, given the sharply higher candidate volume this year compared to earlier cycles.

Why Is the PPSC PCS Mains Result Taking Longer This Year?

PPSC has directly addressed this in its notice: this year's Mains examination saw roughly four to five times more candidates than the Commission has evaluated in previous years' Mains exams. To keep evaluation standards uniform and fair across such a large volume of answer sheets, the Commission says it needs additional time which is why the result is expected only around October 2026 rather than sooner.

Background: About the Punjab PCS (PSCSCCE) Recruitment Cycle

The details in this section are based on prior public reporting around the Punjab PCS 2025–26 cycle (Prelims stage) and are provided for context only. For the Mains result itself, only the official PPSC notice above should be treated as authoritative.

  • Candidates who qualified the Prelims stage subsequently appeared for the Mains examination referenced in PPSC's 15 July 2026 notice.
  • The standard PPSC PCS selection process runs across three stages: Preliminary Examination → Mains (Written) Examination → Interview/Personality Test.

How to Check Your RBI Grade B DEPR Phase-I Result

This section explains the exact process for confirming your roll number in the official result document, so you know where to look and what to avoid.

The result has been published as a roll-number list within an official PDF on the RBI website. Rather than depending on third-party lists, always verify your own status directly.

Phase-II for the DEPR cadre is scheduled for July 26, 2026, and will be conducted in two shifts on the same day. A few important points to note:

What Is the IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026?

This section explains the purpose of the reserve list and why IBPS issues it after the main selection round.

A reserve list is a backup panel that IBPS prepares after declaring the final result of the CRP RRBs-XIV exam. Once the primary list of selected candidates is allotted to participating banks, some vacancies remain unfilled because certain selected candidates do not join within the deadline, resign shortly after joining, or get rejected at the document verification stage. To ensure every sanctioned post is filled, IBPS draws candidates from the reserve panel, based on merit, category, and the number of vacancies still open, and provisionally allots them to a Regional Rural Bank for the Office Assistant/Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post.

This section explains how IBPS notifies candidates who get provisional allotment through the reserve list.

Candidates who are provisionally allotted a bank through the reserve list will receive an official communication via email and SMS on their registered email ID and mobile number. It is advisable to regularly check your registered contact details and the official IBPS portal so you don't miss any update.

What Happens After the Reserve List Allotment?

This section explains the next stages candidates must complete after receiving a provisional allotment.

Getting your name on the reserve list does not mean final selection it is a provisional allotment that becomes confirmed only after the bank completes verification. The typical process that follows includes:

  • Document Verification: Submission of original certificates and identity proofs for cross-checking.
  • Submission of Required Certificates: Educational, category, and other eligibility-related documents as specified by the allotted bank.
  • Medical Examination: Some banks may require a fitness check before final confirmation.
  • Joining Formalities: Completion of paperwork and reporting to the allotted branch.
  • Induction/Training Process: Orientation and training conducted by the bank before you begin regular duties.

Candidates should keep all original and photocopied documents ready in advance to avoid last-minute issues during verification.

Why Does IBPS Release a Reserve List?

This section explains the broader purpose behind the reserve list mechanism in IBPS recruitment.

A reserve list helps maintain smooth recruitment by ensuring sanctioned vacancies don't remain vacant. It benefits candidates who narrowly missed the initial cut-off by giving them another opportunity, while also helping banks manage manpower requirements efficiently across states and categories.

Punjab & Sind Bank Specialist Officers Result 2026 - Security Manager (MMGS II) Interview Shortlist Released

Punjab & Sind Bank (PSB) has officially released the shortlist for the Lateral Recruitment of Specialist Officers - Security Managers (MMGS II) on 10 June 2026. Candidates who applied in response to the advertisement dated 15 April 2026 can now check whether their registration number appears in the provisionally eligible candidates list for the interview round.

Punjab & Sind Bank Security Manager Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Before diving into the shortlist, here is a quick snapshot of this recruitment drive to help you understand the context and timeline at a glance.

Detail Information
Bank Name Punjab & Sind Bank (A Govt. of India Undertaking)
Post Name Specialist Officer - Security Manager

What Does "Provisionally Eligible" Mean?

This section clarifies the significance of appearing on the shortlist, which is a common point of confusion for candidates.

Being listed as "provisionally eligible" means the bank has reviewed your application and found it to meet the preliminary criteria set out in the original advertisement. However, provisional eligibility does not guarantee final selection. Your candidature remains subject to verification of original documents, eligibility criteria, and satisfactory performance in the interview process.

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Candidates should check the official notification for the exact category-wise age relaxation applicable to them.

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

  • A photocopy of the photo ID for verification
  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

RRB Technician Eligibility Criteria 2026

RRB Technician Selection Process 2026

Candidates often ask how RRB selects Technicians, and the answer is a three-stage process based purely on merit. The recruitment involves a Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification (DV), and a Medical Examination, with shortlisting at each stage determined by performance in the previous one.

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT): A single CBT of 90 minutes with 100 questions and negative marking of 1/3rd mark per wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% (UR/EWS), 30% (OBC-NCL/SC), and 25% (ST).
  2. Document Verification (DV): Candidates are shortlisted at a 1:1 ratio against vacancies based on CBT merit, RRB-wise. Original documents must be produced; no extra time is given for missing certificates.
  3. Medical Examination (ME): Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities as per the medical standard (A3, B1, B2, or C1) prescribed for the specific post.

Based on typical RRB recruitment cycles, CBT is expected a few months after the application closes, followed by DV and medical examination in subsequent phases - though exact dates will be announced on official RRB websites.

How to Apply for RRB Technician CEN 02/2026

Candidates wanting to apply online for RRB Technician 2026 need to first create an account before filling the application form. The process is entirely online, and applicants must choose only one RRB per pay level since selecting more than one RRB for the same pay level leads to rejection of all applications.

  1. Visit the official RRB website relevant to your region or the centralised portal at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
  2. Click on "Create an Account" and enter your name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth exactly as per your Matriculation certificate.
  3. Use DigiLocker or Aadhaar for identity authentication to ensure smoother verification later.
  4. Log in and fill the online application form, selecting your preferred RRB and Pay Level (5 or 2).
  5. Provide order of preference for posts under the chosen RRB and Pay Level.
  6. Capture your live photograph through webcam or mobile camera as instructed (pre-existing photos are not accepted).
  7. Upload your signature in JPG/JPEG format (30–49 KB, black ink on white paper, running handwriting).
  8. Pay the examination fee online through net banking, debit/credit card, or UPI.
  9. Submit the application and save the registration number for future reference.

RRB Technician Salary and Pay Scale 2026

Candidates curious about RRB Technician in-hand salary should note that pay depends on the post and pay level assigned. Technician Grade-I Signal carries a higher starting pay than Technician Grade-III posts, as shown below.

Post 7th CPC Pay Level Initial Pay
Technician Grade-I Signal Level-5 ₹29,200

Selected candidates will undergo training wherever prescribed, during which only a stipend is paid rather than full pay.

RRB Technician Document Requirements

Candidates shortlisted for Document Verification must carry all original certificates along with two sets of self-attested photocopies. Required documents include Matriculation/educational qualification certificates, ITI/Apprenticeship certificates, caste/category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS as applicable in the prescribed Annexure format), a valid original photo ID, and an NOC from the current employer if already employed in government service.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying for RRB Technician 2026

Many candidates lose their candidature due to avoidable errors rather than ineligibility. Being aware of these common pitfalls can help applicants submit a clean, error-free application the first time.

  • Entering wrong name/DOB: Details in "Create an Account" cannot be changed later - always match them exactly with your Matriculation certificate.
  • Applying to multiple RRBs for the same Pay Level: This leads to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams.
  • Uploading a pre-existing or printed photo: Only live-captured photographs are accepted; printed photo uploads cause summary rejection.
  • Signature in capital/block letters: Signatures must be in cursive running handwriting with black ink - block letters are grounds for rejection.
  • Missing the fee payment deadline: Fee must be paid by 31 July 2026, two days after the application deadline - don't assume submission alone is enough.
  • Ignoring the modification window: Errors (other than account details and chosen RRB) can be corrected only between 1–10 August 2026 by paying ₹250 per modification.

  • Section A: Technical knowledge (discipline-related), 70 MCQs.
  • Section B: General Knowledge, General Awareness, Reasoning, Verbal & Mental Ability, and Quantitative Aptitude, 30 MCQs.
  • Each question carries 1 mark; there is no negative marking for wrong answers, and no marks for unattempted questions.
  • The question paper is bilingual (English and Hindi); in case of ambiguity, the English version is valid and final.
  • The CBT will be held at Test Cities as mentioned in the online application form; candidates may opt for their preferred city, which cannot be changed after submission.

NCL Recruitment 2026: Syllabus

Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C - Section A (70 Marks)

  • Opencast coal mine working; bench formation, dump management, and haul road design
  • Shot firing and transport and use of explosives in mines
  • Safety issues in opencast workings, transport of material, working at heights, marching and deployment of heavy machines
  • Preliminary idea about reclamation operation in opencast mining
  • Preliminary understanding of safety management plan
  • Provisions of the Coal Mines Regulations 2017, Rules and Bye-laws under the Mines Act 1952, relating to safety of persons employed in mines and duties of Sirdars and Shot firers
  • Mines Rules 1955, Mines Vocational Training Rules 1966, Mines Rescue Rules 1985, DGMS Circulars
  • Writing of reports

Mine Surveyor T&S Gr. B - Section A (70 Marks)

  • Linear measurement, chain surveying, optical square
  • EDM: principles, types, correction, and selection of instruments
  • Angular measurement: prismatic compass, bearing of lines, local attraction, magnetic declination
  • Plan table surveying and contouring
  • Miners' dials and other compass instruments
  • Theodolite, traversing, and traverse calculations
  • Total stations: surveying, errors, adjustments, applications
  • Levelling: instruments, types, geometrical, trigonometric and physical levelling, contouring
  • Tachometry
  • Controlled surveys: triangulation, trilateration, GPS and total station applications
  • Field astronomy, Gyro Theodolite, azimuth determination
  • National grid, map projections, geodesy
  • Photogrammetry and remote sensing in mining
  • Theory of errors and adjustments
  • Area and volume calculation, earthwork estimation
  • Borehole surveying, dip, strike, outcrop and fault problems
  • Mine plans, legislation, and duties of surveyors
  • Geological map reading
  • Computer applications in mine surveying, 3D laser profiling
  • Dump/high wall stability monitoring
  • Software knowledge: Surpac, AutoCAD, Liscad, Autoplotter, Riscan Pro
  • Modern survey equipment: 3D Terrestrial Laser Scanner, GPS, Drone

Section B (Common for All Posts, 30 Marks)

  • General Knowledge - India and international relations, General Science
  • General Awareness - Sports, Defense, Books, Prizes, Indian democracy
  • Reasoning, Verbal & Mental Ability - Synonym & Antonym (Hindi/English), Grammar, Relationship
  • Quantitative Aptitude - Work relationship, Profit & Loss, Speed

  • Scanned copy of recent passport-size color photograph (not older than 3 weeks, jpg/jpeg format)
  • Scanned copy of signature in black ink pen (jpg/jpeg format)
  • Scanned copy of Matriculation/Secondary Board level certificate
  • For Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C: valid Mining Sirdar/Overman's Certificate of Competency issued by DGMS, valid Gas Testing Certificate, valid First Aid Certificate
  • For Surveyor (Mining) T&S Gr. B: valid Surveyor's Certificate of Competency (SCC)
  • For Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C: scanned copy of Degree/Diploma in Mining Engineering (if applicable)
  • For Surveyor T&S Gr. B: scanned copy of Degree/Diploma in Mining/Mine Surveying Engineering (if applicable)
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/SC/ST candidates: self-attested valid caste certificate in prescribed format
  • EWS candidates: self-attested valid Income & Asset certificate as per OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt(Res) dated 31.01.2019, based on FY 2025-2026 gross annual income
  • Self-attested certificate in prescribed format for J&K domicile (if applicable)

NCL Recruitment 2026: How to Apply

  1. Log in to the official NCL website using URL www.nclcil.in > Career > Recruitment > Employment Notification for Direct Recruitment of various Statutory posts > Apply Online.
  2. Read the complete Employment Notification carefully (available in English and Hindi) to assess your eligibility.
  3. Candidates other than SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental Candidates must pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹1180/- through the online facility.
  4. Upload the scanned photograph, signature, and all required documents as specified in the notification.
  5. A candidate can apply for only a single post against this Employment Notification.
  6. Verify all details (Date of Birth, Category, Contact Details, Qualifications) carefully before final submission, as no correction is possible after submission.
  7. If more than one application is received from a candidate, the most recent application will be treated as final.
  8. No hard copies of the application or testimonials need to be posted or dispatched to NCL.

Important Instructions

  • A candidate can apply for only one post against this Employment Notification.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by AICTE/UGC/appropriate Indian Statutory Authorities.
  • Mere issuance of Admit Card does not imply that candidature has been finally cleared by NCL; candidature remains provisional until eligibility is verified against original documents after clearing the CBT.
  • No relaxation in minimum educational qualification is admissible for any category of candidate.
  • Where Grade (CGPA/OGPA/DGPA) is awarded, a conversion certificate from the concerned Board/University must be produced at the time of document verification.
  • Candidates employed in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies must produce a 'No Objection Certificate' at the time of document verification, if shortlisted, and must resign from their present job before joining NCL upon final selection.
  • Selected candidates could be posted at any NCL Mine/Establishment and are liable to be transferred to other Coal India Limited subsidiaries during service.
  • Appointment is subject to candidates being found medically fit as per CIL's Medical Examination Rules.
  • SC/ST candidates called for CBT will be paid up to IInd Class Non-AC fare as per rules, subject to submitting the TA Claim format with required enclosures.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in CBT, scrutiny/verification, or joining, except as provided in the notification.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be the Honorable High Court of Jabalpur, M.P.
  • In case of any ambiguity, the English version of the Employment Notification will be considered valid.
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least the next one year, as all correspondence will be through these or the NCL website.

Eligibility Criteria for Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course

Nationality

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, and the East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, and Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India (a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India is required for these categories, except Gorkha subjects of Nepal).

Marital Status

Open only to unmarried male and unmarried female law graduates.

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum 55% aggregate marks in LLB Degree (three years professional course after graduation, or five years after 10+2 examination).
  • CLAT PG 2026 Score (conducted in December 2025) is mandatory for all candidates, including LLM-qualified and LLM-appearing candidates. No other CLAT PG exam score will be accepted.
  • Candidates must be eligible for registration as an advocate with the Bar Council of India/State.
  • The LLB degree must be from a College/University recognized by the Bar Council of India.
  • All candidates applying for JAG Entry must get their CLAT PG 2026 result verified at the Selection Centre before the SSB is conducted - failure to do so makes the candidate ineligible for SSB, with no representation accepted.

Candidates holding a law degree can also explore more LLB Government Jobs and Law Graduate Government Jobs available across India.

Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course Age Limit

Particulars Details

Date of Birth Range Not earlier than 02 Jan 2000 and not later than 01 Jan 2006 (both dates inclusive)

The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate (or equivalent) on the date of application submission will be treated as final; no subsequent request for change will be considered.

Indian Army JAG Salary and Pay Scale

  • Stipend during training at OTA, Chennai: ₹56,100 per month.
  • Rank after training: Lieutenant.
  • Pay Level on commissioning: Level 10, ₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500.
  • Military Service Pay (MSP): ₹15,500 per month (Lieutenant to Brigadier).
  • Approximate CTC on commissioning: ₹17–18 lakh per annum.
  • Additional allowances (as applicable and subject to eligibility conditions): Dearness Allowance, Para Allowance, Field Area Allowances, Dress Allowance, Transport Allowance, Children Education Allowance, Hostel Subsidy, among others specified in the notification.

Application Fee

Not specified in the notification.

Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course Selection Process

  1. Application submission and shortlisting (based on CLAT PG 2026 score and vacancy-to-call-up ratio).
  2. Selection of SSB Centre and Date (first-come-first-served, once selected cannot be changed by the candidate).
  3. SSB Interview (two-stage selection at Prayagraj, Bhopal, Bengaluru, or Jalandhar) - duration up to five days. Candidates failing Stage-I are returned the same day.
  4. Medical Examination for candidates recommended after Stage-II.
  5. Merit List preparation based on SSB marks.
  6. Joining Letter for Pre-Commission Training at OTA, Chennai, subject to eligibility and vacancy.

Qualifying the SSB interview alone does not confirm final selection - final selection depends on the merit list and availability of vacancies.

How to Apply for Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course

  1. Visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in and click on 'Officer Entry Application/Login'.
  2. Click 'Registration' (not required if already registered on the website).
  3. Fill the online registration form after reading the instructions carefully.
  4. After registration, click 'Apply Online' under the Dashboard.
  5. On the 'Officer Selection – Eligibility' page, click 'Apply' against Short Service Commission JAG Entry Course.
  6. Fill in personal information, communication details, education details, and previous SSB details (if any) under the 'Application Form' page.
  7. Review the summary of information, then click 'Submit' only after confirming all details are correct.
  8. Take two printouts of the application (with roll number) 30 minutes after the online application closes on the last day.

Important Instructions

  • No changes can be made to the online application after it closes; no representation on this will be entertained.
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted to marks as per the university's formula before filling in the application.
  • The candidate's name, parents' names, and date of birth in the profile and application must match the Matriculation/Secondary School certificate exactly.
  • Only one online application per candidate is allowed; multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates serving in the Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer in writing and carry a countersigned application to the SSB.
  • Requests to change the SSB interview date or centre will not be entertained.
  • Candidates must report within 7 days of their candidature reporting date, or their candidature will be cancelled.
  • Candidates who marry after the date of application, or during training, will lose eligibility or be withdrawn from training.
  • In case of any discrepancy between the English and Hindi versions of the notification, the English version shall prevail.

WCL Recruitment 2026: Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Post Minimum Qualification & Eligibility Criteria
Mining Sirdar, T&S Grade-C (a) Valid Mining Sirdar Certificate of Competency issued by DGMS, Valid Gas Testing Certificate, Valid First-Aid Certificate, and 3 years' experience working in Underground Mines; OR (b) Diploma in Mining Engineering from a Government-recognized institute, Valid Overman competency certificate issued by DGMS, Valid Gas Testing Certificate, and Valid First-Aid Certificate.

WCL Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by document scrutiny/verification and a medical examination.

WCL CBT Exam Pattern 2026

  • The CBT consists of 100 questions: Part 1 – General Aptitude (20 questions); Part 2 – Technical (80 questions). Each question carries 1 mark.
  • Duration: 90 minutes. Questions are multiple-choice with four options.
  • There is no negative marking; no marks are awarded for unattempted questions.
  • The question paper is bilingual (English and Hindi); in case of any discrepancy, the English version is valid and final.
Post Maximum Marks Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
Mining Sirdar, T&S Grade-C 100 UR & EWS 50 Marks
OBC (NCL) 45 Marks
SC/ST 40 Marks
Assistant Foreman (Trainee) (Electrical)/Electrical Supervisor, T&S Grade-C 100 UR & EWS 50 Marks
OBC (NCL) 45 Marks
SC/ST 40 Marks
  • Candidates are shortlisted for document verification based on CBT marks; the zone of consideration is 3 times the number of vacancies in each category.
  • In case of a tie in CBT marks, it is resolved first by Date of Birth (elder candidate ranked higher), then by alphabetic order of first name as per the Matriculation certificate.
  • A Merit Panel is published on the WCL website after document verification, followed by a provisional offer of appointment based on relative merit and reservation norms.
  • Candidature will be cancelled if a candidate is found ineligible at any stage — during scrutiny, during probation, or even during the course of employment.

WCL Mining Sirdar Syllabus 2026 (Part 2 highlights)

Beyond the common General Aptitude section (English, reasoning, quantitative aptitude, data interpretation, and current affairs), the Mining Sirdar technical syllabus covers: Explosives and Blasting Practice; Board and Pillar development/depillaring methods; Strata control and support systems; Stowing; Opencast working methods; Drifting; Geology; Mine Surveying; Danger of Inundation; Mine Fires and firefighting; Mine Rescue; Mine Ventilation and gases; Duties of Sirdar; Man-riding systems; Winding and shaft safety; Shaft sinking; Coal dust regulations; Accident classification; Face machineries; basic mine electrical systems; and provisions of the Mines Act 1952, Coal Mines Regulations 2017, and related DGMS circulars. Full syllabus is enclosed as Annexure I of the notification.

WCL Assistant Foreman (Electrical) Syllabus 2026 (Part 2 highlights)

Beyond the common General Aptitude section, the technical syllabus covers: Basics of Electrical Engineering (Ohm's Law, Kirchhoff's Law, power factor, safety devices); Power generation economics; Electrical Machineries (motors, generators, transformers); Electric Drives and Control (VFDs, PLC, SCADA, DCS); Switchgear and protective devices; Earthing systems (IS-3043); Neutral systems of power supply; Sub-station design and safety; Overhead lines and underground cables; General electrical safety and first aid; relevant legislation (CEA Regulations 2023, Electricity Act 2003, NBC 2016); and on-site emergency management planning. Full syllabus is enclosed as Annexure II of the notification.

WCL Recruitment 2026: Reservation Policy

  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD/ESM follows applicable Government of India Acts, rules, and guidelines in force at the time of finalization of results.
  • SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates selected purely on merit (without relaxed standards) are adjusted against Unreserved vacancies, not reserved ones; those selected using relaxed standards are counted against reserved vacancies.
  • ESM/PwBD reservation is horizontal: General category ESM/PwBD are adjusted against UR, OBC-NCL category ESM/PwBD against OBC-NCL vacancies, and SC/ST category ESM/PwBD against SC/ST vacancies.
  • OBC(NCL) candidates must upload a valid Non-Creamy Layer caste certificate and self-declaration; the certificate must confirm the candidate does not fall in the Creamy Layer as on the cut-off date.
  • EWS candidates must submit a valid Income & Asset Certificate based on gross annual income for Financial Year 2025-26, as per DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt(Res) dated 31.01.2019.
  • Only persons with not less than 40% benchmark disability are eligible for PwBD relaxation/reservation; the original disability certificate must be submitted at document verification.
  • PwBD candidates may opt for a Scribe facility if desired, per applicable GoI provisions, and must submit a Scribe certificate in the prescribed proforma at the time of reporting for the CBT.
  • Ex-Servicemen who have already secured regular Group C/D Government employment after availing ESM reservation benefits are not eligible for ESM reservation and fee concession again, except under specific self-declaration conditions per DOP&T OM No. 36034/1/2014-Estt.(Res) dated 14.08.2014.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, has invited online applications for Group 'B' Para-medical posts through Direct Recruitment. Advertisement No. 06/2026 (R-I) covers 6 vacancies of Scientific Assistant in Psychology, Pathology, Radiography, and Nuclear Medicine Technology, to be posted at BARC Mumbai and Radiation Medicine Research Centre (RMRC), Kolkata. Eligible candidates can apply online at recruit.barc.gov.in from 17 July 2026 to 18 August 2026. This article covers eligibility, age limit, pay scale, application fee, selection process, and the complete application procedure.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

BARC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The official notification was released under Advertisement No. 06/2026 (R-I) by the Department of Atomic Energy, Bhabha Atomic Research Centre. Candidates are advised to read the full notification carefully before applying, as eligibility, category, and other conditions are determined strictly with reference to the closing date of application.

  • BARC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Particular Details

Advertisement Number 06/2026 (R-I)

Total Vacancies 6 (Unreserved)
Group / Recruitment Mode Group 'B', Direct Recruitment
Application Mode Online only
Job Location BARC, Mumbai and RMRC, Kolkata
Selection Process Personal Interview (screening test possible if response is high)
Application Fee ₹150 (exempted for SC/ST and Women candidates)

Total 6 (Unreserved)

All 6 posts are Unreserved (UR) as per the current notification. The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation, and filling of the posts is subject to approval of the Competent Authority.

BARC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational qualification requirements differ by post code. All eligibility criteria, including period of experience, will be determined with reference to the closing date of application, 18.08.2026.

Post Code Post Qualification and Experience
DR/01 Scientific Assistant/C (Psychologist) Graduation in Psychology with minimum 60% marks, PLUS Post Graduation in Applied Psychology/Psychology with specialization in Clinical Psychology or Counselling Psychology with minimum 50% marks. Minimum one year Hospital/Clinical experience after acquiring the postgraduate degree will be given preference.
DR/02 Scientific Assistant/B (Pathology) B.Sc with minimum 60% marks followed by postgraduate Diploma in Medical Lab Technology (DMLT) with minimum 60% marks, OR B.Sc (Medical Lab Technology) with minimum 60% marks.
DR/03 Scientific Assistant/B (Radiography) B.Sc (Radiography) with minimum 60% marks, OR B.Sc with minimum 50% marks plus one year Diploma in Radiography.
DR/04 Scientific Assistant/B (Nuclear Medicine Technologist) B.Sc with minimum 60% marks plus DMRIT/DNMT/DFIT (Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology) with minimum 50% marks, OR B.Sc (NMT) (Nuclear Medicine Technology) with minimum 60% marks.

Candidates who have not acquired the requisite educational qualification as on the closing date of the online application (18.08.2026) will not be eligible and need not apply. Where letter grades/CGPA/OGPA/SGPA are awarded, candidates must convert these to equivalent percentage as per their University/Board norms and be able to produce proof of conversion at the time of document verification.

BARC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

Age is calculated as on the closing date, 18.08.2026. Only the Date of Birth indicated in the School Leaving Certificate or equivalent certificate will be accepted; no subsequent request for change will be granted.

Post Code Post Minimum Age Maximum Age
DR/01 Scientific Assistant/C (Psychologist) 18 30
DR/02 Scientific Assistant/B (Pathology) 18 30
DR/03 Scientific Assistant/B (Radiography) 18 30
DR/04 Scientific Assistant/B (Nuclear Medicine Technologist) 18 30

Upper age relaxation is admissible as follows:

  • Departmental candidates with at least 3 years of continuous and regular service in the same line or allied cadre as on the last date of receipt of application, as per Government of India Orders.
  • 5 years' relaxation for children/family members of those who died in the 1984 Riots.
  • Widows, divorced women, and women judicially separated from their husbands and not re-married, as per Government of India Orders.
  • Meritorious sportspersons, as per Government of India Orders.

The notification does not specify separate age relaxation figures for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories; candidates claiming any age relaxation must produce documentary proof.

Post Code Post Group of Service Level in Pay Matrix Entry Pay

DR/03 Scientific Assistant/B (Radiography) B 6 ₹35,400

In addition to entry pay, allowances will be admissible under Central Government Rules. Additional benefits include an exciting working environment, promotions under DAE's Merit Promotion Scheme, healthcare for self and family members, attractive performance-related incentives, professional update allowance, Leave Travel Concession, Children Education Allowance, and Departmental Accommodation as per Government of India Orders. Selected candidates will be governed by the National Pension System (NPS) or Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as per Government orders.

Category Application Fee
General / OBC / EWS ₹150
SC / ST Exempted
Women (all categories) Exempted
  • Mode of payment is online only, through the "Make Payment" option under the "My Account" menu after the application number is generated.

  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and cannot be held in reserve for any other recruitment.
  • If applying for more than one post, application and fee must be submitted separately for each post.

BARC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for all four posts (DR/01 to DR/04) will be based on performance in a personal interview. If the number of applications received is high, BARC reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview by conducting a screening test in the respective discipline. The decision of the Centre in this regard will be final and binding.

Nature of Duties

  • Scientific Assistant/C (Psychologist): Hospital-based, Occupational Health Care-based, School and Community-based Counselling Services.
  • Scientific Assistant/B (Pathology): Shift duties in the Pathology Laboratory, covering Emergency Laboratory, Phlebotomy, Clinical Pathology, Biochemistry, Hematology, Microbiology (including virology facility), Blood Bank, and Immunology.
  • Scientific Assistant/B (Radiography): Handling various X-ray machines, general radiography including portable X-rays for inwards and operation theatre, special radiological investigations, and handling advanced imaging modalities like computerised radiography, digital radiography, USG, CT, and MRI.
  • Scientific Assistant/B (Nuclear Medicine Technologist): Performing nuclear medicine studies using radioisotopes on uptake probe, gamma camera SPECT systems, and PET/CT scanner; patient preparation and positioning; dispensing and administration of radiopharmaceuticals; data acquisition and analysis; equipment performance assurance; handling radioactive sources; and teaching support for HBNI academic programs including MD (Nuclear Medicine) and MSc courses in Nuclear Medicine Technology & Hospital Radiopharmacy and Nuclear Medicine and Molecular Imaging Technology.

How to Apply for BARC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website recruit.barc.gov.in and read the "How to apply" instructions on the home page.
  2. Register and fill in the online application form with the required personal, educational, and post-related details.
  3. Submit the application to generate an Application Number.
  4. Go to "My Account" → "Make Payment," select the Application Number, and complete the online application fee payment (unless exempted).
  5. Apply and pay separately if applying for more than one post; only one application is acceptable per post.
  6. Submit the online application well in advance, without waiting for the closing date of 18.08.2026.
  7. Keep the e-mail ID and mobile number provided in the application active throughout the recruitment process, and check the website regularly for updates.
  8. On being shortlisted, download the admit card from the website and report for the written test/interview with all required original documents and self-attested copies.

BARC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only online applications will be accepted; the facility is open from 17.07.2026 to 18.08.2026.
  • Fulfilling the eligibility requirements does not by itself qualify a candidate to be called for the written test/interview.
  • Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation; BARC reserves the right to cancel, restrict, modify, or alter the recruitment process without notice.
  • Wait-listed candidates will be offered appointment only if a candidate in the main list does not join; the wait list is valid for one year from the date of preparation of the select panel, or until a fresh recruitment is notified, whichever is earlier.
  • Furnishing false information will lead to disqualification at any stage, including after appointment.
  • Distance-education B.Sc./M.Sc. qualifications must be from institutions recognized by the Distance Education Bureau (DEB-UGC); technical programmes must be recognized by AICTE, NCTE, or the Ministry of HRD, as applicable.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates must indicate their category in the application, even when applying against a UR vacancy, and furnish proof at the time of written test/interview; failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.
  • Candidates should come prepared to stay in Mumbai for 2 to 3 days for the written test/interview.
  • Posting of selected candidates will be at the discretion of the Competent Authority, and they are liable to serve in any part of India, in any Constituent Unit of the Department of Atomic Energy; duties may involve shift work, round-the-clock shifts, and field work.
  • Candidates may answer the written test/interview in Hindi or English, as per their choice.
  • SC/ST outstation candidates called for the written test/interview will be paid to-and-fro second-class railway fare by the shortest route as per rules, subject to submission of the TA Claim form and supporting documents; this is not admissible to those already in Central/State Government service or PSUs.
  • Records of non-selected candidates will not be preserved beyond 6 months from the date of formation of the Select List.
  • Any dispute related to this recruitment is subject to the jurisdiction of courts in Mumbai only.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

BEML Limited, India's leading multi-technology company under the Ministry of Defence, has invited online applications for the Recruitment of Executives vide Advertisement No. KP/S/12/2026 dated 08.07.2026. The recruitment covers 20 distinct executive positions - ranging from Engineer (Grade II) to Executive Director (Grade X) - across BEML's Defence & Aerospace, Rail & Metro, Power, Mining, and Construction business verticals. Online applications close on 1 August 2026 at 18:00 Hrs. This article covers position-wise vacancy details, eligibility, pay scale, age limit, application fee, selection process, and the complete application procedure.

  • Category-wise vacancy break-up (SC/ST/OBC/EWS reservation) will be as per applicable Government rules.

  • PQE is the minimum relevant experience the candidate should possess after obtaining the qualification; only employment after obtaining the requisite qualification will be considered.
  • Age, Qualification, and Experience are reckoned as on 01.08.2026.

BEML Age Relaxation 2026

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years relaxation in upper age limit.
  • OBC (NCL) candidates: 3 years relaxation in upper age limit.
  • PwD candidates: additional 10 years relaxation, over and above the relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates; permissible for candidates with a minimum of 40% disability.
  • The upper age limit can be relaxed for candidates in all categories, subject to equivalent years of excess PQE - however, the maximum age with relaxation shall not exceed 57 years (58 years for Position Code 102).
  • Candidates applying for Position Code 102 must have served as Brigadier from the Indian Army; the maximum age cap for this position is 58 years.

BEML Executive Recruitment 2026: Salary and Pay Scale

Pay scales range from ₹40,000–1,40,000 (Grade II, Engineer) to ₹1,50,000–3,00,000 (Grade X, Executive Director) - see the grade-wise Eligibility table above for the full breakup.

  • Besides Basic Pay, candidates are eligible for Variable Dearness Allowance, Perquisites and Allowances (currently 15.12% of applicable Basic Pay under the Cafeteria System), Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance, Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Performance Related Pay (PRP), as per prevailing Company Rules.
  • Pay fixation will be guided by the extant rules of BEML Limited applicable at the time of issuance of the Offer of Appointment.

BEML Recruitment 2026: Application Fee

Category Application Fee
GEN/EWS/OBC ₹500/- (non-refundable)
SC/ST/PwD Not applicable (exempted)

Eligible GEN/EWS/OBC candidates must pay the fee online by clicking "Pay Application Fee Online" at the end of the application form.

BEML Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for assessment. Merely meeting the advertised conditions does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for assessment.
  • Management reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates and increase the qualifying percentage based on the number of applications received.
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo a pre-employment medical examination and original document verification. This does not necessarily mean selection.
  • Any shortcoming at document verification - such as falsification of documents, wrong declaration of age/category/qualifying marks, or non-production of original records (including category certificate) - will lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to meeting BEML's medical standards and receipt of a satisfactory medical report from the Company Medical Officer.
  • Intimation regarding assessments and issuance of provisional/final offers will be sent only through email; the list of shortlisted/selected candidates will be uploaded on the Company's website.
  • Management reserves the right to offer appointment in a lower grade if found suitable, subject to eligibility and organizational requirement.

BEML Recruitment 2026: Category Certificate Requirements

  • SC/ST candidates must submit an SC/ST Caste Certificate in the Government of India format.
  • OBC candidates must submit an Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in the Government of India format, along with a self-undertaking of Non-Creamy Layer status. The OBC (NCL) certificate must not be older than six months as on the last date of online application submission.
  • PwD candidates must submit a PwD Certificate in the Government of India format.
  • EWS candidates must submit an Income and Assets Certificate in the format applicable for Economically Weaker Sections.

BEML Recruitment 2026: Documents Required

Along with the online application, candidates must upload the following, without which the application will be incomplete and rejected:

  1. Xth Marks card
  2. XIIth Marks card
  3. Qualifying Degree Marks cards (with CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula as per University norms, if applicable)
  4. Post-Graduation Marks cards, as applicable
  5. Post-Graduation Certificate, as applicable
  6. Identity card issued by Government of India (e.g. Aadhaar, Passport, Driving Licence, PAN Card)
  7. Detailed Resume
  8. OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwD certificate (as applicable)
  9. All Experience Certificates/Documents, clearly indicating start and end dates of each employment
  10. Latest pay-slip
  11. Current reporting structure (for candidates applying to DGM/GM/CGM positions)
  12. Company credentials proving turnover (for candidates applying for GM, CGM, and ED positions)

How to Apply for BEML Recruitment 2026

  1. Applications must be submitted ONLINE only - this is mandatory. Read the prescribed guidelines carefully before applying.
  2. Access the online application form on BEML's career page at www.bemlindia.in. The registration site is available till 18:00 Hrs on 01.08.2026.
  3. A valid email and mobile number are required for registration; these will be used for all further correspondence and cannot be changed once submitted.
  4. Note the Registration Number generated for all future correspondence.
  5. While filling the experience section, list the latest experience first followed by previous ones, and write a "pen picture" of at least 150 words for each experience relevant to the position applied for. Unclear or irrelevant information in this section will lead to rejection of candidature.
  6. Upload all required documents listed above before final submission.

For queries, candidates may email: [email protected]. Incomplete applications without the required uploaded documents will be summarily rejected.

BEML Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions for Government/PSU Employees

  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government, Autonomous Bodies, Quasi-Government, or PSU should forward their application through proper channel (printout of the online form) within 10 days of the closing date, addressed to: Sr. Manager, Recruitment Cell, BEML Soudha, BEML Limited, 23/1, 4th Main, S.R. Nagar, Bengaluru 560027 - OR produce a "No Objection Certificate" specific to the position applied for, from their current employer, at the time of assessment.
  • Candidates from Central/State Government, Autonomous Bodies, Quasi-Government, or PSU applying without a proper channel or NOC will be permitted to attend the interview, provided they can submit a proper relieving letter from their current organization at the time of joining. However, they will not be eligible for pay protection or carry-forward of past service benefits in such a case.
  • Such candidates should also have worked for at least one year in the immediately lower scale - this is not applicable to Grade-II positions.

BEML Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions for Private Sector Candidates

  • Private sector candidates must be employed in a regular capacity in a company registered under the Companies Act, and must submit an experience certificate on the company's letterhead while applying, clearly stating their current reporting structure. Freelance experience will not be considered as part of Post Qualification Experience.
  • Private sector candidates applying for Executive Director, Chief General Manager, or General Manager positions must be employed in a company with an annual turnover of ₹1,000 crore or more. Preference will be given to candidates from listed companies.

BEML Recruitment 2026: Other Important Instructions

  • Internal BEML candidates (Executive cadre) meeting the advertised criteria are eligible, provided their application (printout of the online form) is received through the proper channel, and they have a minimum of 3 years of residual service as on the closing date of the advertisement.
  • Any request for change in category, address, email, mobile number, etc., as declared in the online application, will not be entertained.
  • Any canvassing or influencing of officials related to the recruitment/selection process will result in immediate disqualification.
  • If any information furnished by a candidate is found to be false or suppressed, the candidature stands automatically cancelled - even after appointment, with services liable to be terminated without notice.
  • Corrigendum/Addendum, if any, will be hosted only on the BEML website.

The Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has released Advt. No. 2/2026 (R&P) inviting online applications for the recruitment of Geologists and Engineers at E1 Level through a Computer Based Test (CBT). There are 52 vacancies across five streams: Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, and Geology. Online registration starts on 17 July 2026 and closes on 31 July 2026. This article covers vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, salary, application fee, selection process, and the complete application procedure.

ONGC E1 Level Vacancy Details 2026

The 52 vacancies are distributed across five Academic/Engineering streams as follows:

SN Stream Total
1 Petroleum Engineering 9
2 Mechanical Engineering 27
3 Chemical Engineering 10
4 Instrumentation Engineering 2
5 Geology 4
Grand Total   52

Note: "1*" against SC in Mechanical Engineering denotes a carried-forward unfilled vacancy from a previous advertisement. Reservation for Persons with Benchmarked Disabilities (PwBD) is as per existing government guidelines; identified benchmarked disabilities are detailed separately for each stream in the official notification.

  • Candidates with a Petroleum Engineering qualification will be considered for all 9 vacancies in that stream.
  • Candidates with an Applied Petroleum Engineering qualification will be considered for only 7 of those 9 vacancies (UR-3, OBC-2, SC-1, EWS-1).

ONGC Recruitment 2026: Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Stream-Wise)

Stream Essential Qualification
Petroleum Engineering Graduate Degree in Petroleum Engineering (min. 60% marks) OR Graduate Degree in Applied Petroleum Engineering (min. 60% marks)
Mechanical Engineering Graduate Degree in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 60% marks
Chemical Engineering Graduate Degree in Chemical Engineering with minimum 60% marks
Instrumentation Engineering Graduate Degree in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 60% marks
Geology Post Graduate Degree in Geology (min. 60%) OR M.Sc./M.Tech in Petroleum Geoscience (min. 60%) OR M.Sc./M.Tech in Petroleum Geology (min. 60%) OR M.Tech in Geological Technology (min. 60%)
  • Qualifications must be approved/recognized by relevant statutory bodies (e.g. AIU, UGC, AICTE); Distance Learning/part-time qualifications are accepted only if similarly recognized.
  • Qualifications listed are "sacrosanct" - no equivalent qualification is accepted (for example, AMIE is not accepted where a Graduate Degree in Engineering is required).
  • CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or letter grades must be converted to a percentage as per the university/institute's own conversion norms; a conversion certificate must be submitted at document verification.
  • Only candidates who have already acquired the qualification on or before the last date of application will be considered.
  • BE/B.Tech in Chemical Sciences and Technology will not be accepted for the Chemical Engineering stream.

Level Basic Pay Scale (₹) Allowances
E1 60,000 – 1,80,000/- Annual increment @ 3%; allowances @ 35% of Basic Pay under Cafeteria Approach; Dearness Allowance; HRA/Company Accommodation; Contributory Provident Fund; Conveyance Maintenance; Leave Encashment; Performance Related Pay (PRP); Medical Facility for self and dependents; Gratuity; Post Retirement Benefit Scheme; Composite Social Security Scheme, etc., as per Company rules.

ONGC states the overall package is approximately ₹26 lacs CTC.

  • ONGC departmental candidates must also pay the applicable fee, which is reimbursable to them.

ONGC Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

Selection consists of three stages:

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT)
  2. Interview
  3. Medical Fitness (as per ONGC Medical Examination of Employees Rules)

Only candidates who qualify all three stages will be issued an Offer of Appointment. CBT scores are used to shortlist candidates for interview in a 1:5 ratio per category (all candidates meeting the cut-off are shortlisted even if this exceeds the ratio). Shortlisted candidates may also be subjected to a Group Discussion, which is not of qualifying nature.

Weightage for Final Selection

Parameter Marks
CBT Score 85
Interview 15
Total 100

Qualifying Marks

  • CBT: General/EWS/OBC candidates need a minimum of 45%; SC/ST/PwBD candidates need a minimum of 40%.
  • Interview: General/EWS/OBC candidates need a minimum of 60% (9 out of 15 marks); SC/ST/PwBD candidates need a minimum of 40% (6 out of 15 marks).

Part Subject Number of Questions

  • The CBT is Multiple-Choice Question based, of 2 hours duration.

  • If the exam is held across multiple sessions, scores are normalized to adjust for difficulty-level differences.

ONGC CBT Exam Centres 2026

The CBT will be conducted in 19 cities: Delhi (including NCR), Kolkata, Mumbai/Thane/Navi Mumbai/MMR, Chennai, Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar, Hyderabad, Guwahati, Jaipur, Udaipur, Mohali, Nagpur, Bhopal, Bengaluru, Ernakulum, Raipur, Surat, Lucknow, Visakhapatnam, and Bhubaneswar.

Candidates must give a test-centre preference at the time of application; changes are not allowed later, though ONGC reserves the right to change, add, or reduce test cities/centres at its discretion.

ONGC Recruitment 2026: Documents Required

Candidates should keep the following ready before starting the online application:

  • Mobile number and email ID (for OTP)
  • Scanned passport-size colour photograph with white background (JPG/JPEG, 20kb–50kb)
  • Scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 10kb–20kb)
  • Class 10th Certificate (for date of birth verification)
  • Degree Certificate of the essential qualification
  • Consolidated marksheet/transcript for all semesters or years
  • Photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter ID Card)
  • PAN Card

All documents must be uploaded in PDF format, not exceeding 500 kb per file.

How to Apply for ONGC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit www.ongcindia.com and register online between 17/07/2026 and 31/07/2026. No other mode of application is accepted.
  2. Candidates may apply for only one Academic/Engineering Stream, based on their qualification.
  3. Keep the required documents (listed above) ready before starting.
  4. Pay the applicable registration fee online (where applicable).
  5. Submit the application; no changes are allowed once submitted.
  6. If multiple applications are submitted, only the latest one is considered final; older ones are rejected.

All correspondence will be through the registered email/mobile only. No physical admit card or interview call letter will be sent by post - candidates must download these from the ONGC website themselves.

ONGC Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Furnishing wrong or false information will lead to disqualification at any stage, including after joining.
  • No change in mailing address, Academic/Engineering Stream, Test Centre, or mode of interview will be entertained once declared.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates must submit caste certificates in the prescribed proforma at document verification; OBC (NCL) certificates must be issued on or after 01.04.2026.
  • PwBD candidates must submit a benchmarked disability certificate (Form V/VI/VII) at document verification.
  • EWS candidates must submit an Income and Asset Certificate at the time of interview, issued on or after 01.04.2026.
  • Candidates from PSU/Government service must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at document verification/interview.
  • Candidates should resign from current employment only after being declared medically fit by ONGC.
  • SC/ST/PwBD candidates attending CBT, and all candidates attending interviews from outside the test/interview city, will be reimbursed single second-class to-and-fro rail fare by the shortest route (or actual fare, whichever is less).
  • Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India or abroad.
  • Medical standards: complete or partial colour blindness and night blindness are not acceptable for any stream; myopia/hypermetropia within ±4.00 D (including cylinder) is acceptable.
  • Disputes are subject to Delhi jurisdiction only.
  • ONGC does not seek any payment other than the prescribed registration fee; candidates are advised not to respond to unauthorized advertisements and to verify all communication via www.ongcindia.com.

NFR Apprentice Selection Process 2026

  • Selection is purely merit-based, with no written examination. The merit list for each unit is prepared using the percentage of marks in Matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) plus ITI marks in the relevant trade; the final panel is based on the average of the two.
  • For Medical Laboratory Technician (Pathology) and (Radiology), merit is based on Matriculation marks plus 12th Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) marks.
  • Calculation uses marks obtained in all subjects of Matriculation/12th, not select subjects, and the average ITI marks across all semesters (or the National Trade Certificate marks).
  • Merit lists are prepared unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise, in descending order of percentage, equal to the number of notified slots.
  • Shortlisted candidates are called for Document Verification (DV) to the extent of 1.5 times the notified vacancies.
  • A candidate is considered for only one combination of Unit-Department-Trade based on merit and order of preference; once selected against a higher preference, all lower preferences are automatically cancelled.
  • In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate (by age) is ranked higher; if date of birth is also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier is ranked higher.

NFR Apprentice Documents Required

  • Mark sheet and Pass Certificate of Matriculation (Class X) or its equivalent
  • Mark sheet and Pass Certificate of Senior Secondary (Class XII) with Physics, Chemistry and Biology (only for Medical Laboratory Technician posts)
  • Certificate for proof of date of birth, if not mentioned in the Matriculation certificate
  • Consolidated mark sheet for all ITI semesters of the relevant trade, OR Provisional National Trade Certificate indicating marks
  • National Trade Certificate issued by NCVT, or Provisional Trade Certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates
  • Certificate for EWS candidates
  • Disability certificate, for PwBD candidates
  • Discharge certificate/Serving certificate, for candidates applying under the Ex-Servicemen quota
  • Certificate for Economically Backward Class (EBC) candidates seeking fee exemption
  • Colour photograph and scanned signature as per website specifications

Certificates in languages other than English or Hindi must be accompanied by an attested translation in English/Hindi. Originals of all documents must be produced at the time of Document Verification.

How to Apply for NFR Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official NFR website: www.nfr.indianrailways.gov.in
  2. Navigate to General Info → Departments → Personnel → Act Apprentice Notification
  3. Register with your basic details and log in using the credentials generated
  4. Fill in the online application form carefully, indicating your Unit-Department-Trade preferences in order of choice
  5. Upload the required documents, colour photograph, and signature as per specifications
  6. Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹100/- (if applicable) through the payment gateway link
  7. After successful payment, complete the remaining steps and download/print the final application form for your records

Candidates are allowed to submit only one application; submitting more than one application will lead to summary disqualification. A Registration Number is issued on submission and must be preserved for all future correspondence.

NFR Apprentice Important Instructions 2026

  • Candidates must read the training slots against their ITI trade carefully and indicate Unit preferences clearly, since only one combination will be allotted.
  • The candidate is responsible for the correctness of information filled in the online application; false information leads to immediate disqualification.
  • Registered mobile number and email address must not be changed during the entire selection process.
  • Reservation: 10% for EWS, 4% horizontal for PwBD, and 10% horizontal for Ex-Servicemen (ESM); PwBD and ESM slots are included within, not additional to, the notified total.
  • If required numbers of SC candidates are unavailable, the balance is filled by ST candidates and vice versa; unfilled OBC/EWS slots are filled by UR candidates.
  • A medical fitness certificate (Annexure-XI), signed by a Government-authorised doctor not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon, must be submitted at the time of Document Verification; DV will not be conducted without it.
  • Training under the Apprentices Act 1961 does not, by itself, confer any right to appointment in Railway services. However, 20% of vacancies notified for erstwhile Group D (Level-1) posts are filled by giving preference to Course Completed Act Apprentices meeting eligibility conditions.
  • No daily/conveyance/travelling allowance is paid for attending Document Verification.
  • Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification, and no correspondence will be entertained on the matter.
  • Candidates should be aware of and avoid unscrupulous elements promising selection; such instances should be reported to the SDGM/NFR and local police.

AVNL Recruitment 2026: Exam Pattern

The written exam is a single Computer Based Test (CBT), objective multiple-choice type, for a maximum of 100 marks, with no negative marking.

Part Subject Questions Marks
Part A (General Paper) General Awareness 10 10
Part A (General Paper) General English 10 10
Part A (General Paper) Quantitative Aptitude 10 10
Part A (General Paper) Reasoning Ability 10 10
Part A (General Paper) Computer Aptitude 10 10
Part A Total   50 50
Part B (Junior Technician) NCVT syllabus of relevant trade 50 50
Part B (Junior/Assistant/Deputy Manager) Relevant discipline 50 50

Part A questions are up to 10th Standard level for Junior Technician posts, and Graduate level for all other posts. Total time allowed for the written exam is 2 hours. Written exam weightage is 100% for Junior Technician posts and 85% for Junior Manager, Assistant Manager, and Deputy Manager posts. There is no written exam (CBT) for Senior Manager, Deputy General Manager, Additional General Manager, and Consultant posts.

AVNL Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

  • Junior Technician posts: CBT, followed by a qualifying Trade Test (Practical) at the respective AVNL unit. Merit is decided solely on Written Test marks; the Trade Test syllabus is per Annexure-A of the official notification.
  • Junior Manager, Assistant Manager, Deputy Manager posts: CBT, followed by an Interview (50 marks, 15% weightage) assessing technical knowledge, prior work experience, initiative, and decision-making. Merit is decided on combined Written Exam and Interview performance.
  • Senior Manager, Deputy General Manager, Additional General Manager, Consultant posts: No written CBT. Candidates are assessed through Presentation, Experience, Expertise, Knowledge, and Interview, conducted at AVNL CO, Avadi.
  • Candidates qualifying the CBT will be called for Interview (other than Junior Technicians) or Trade Test (Junior Technicians) in a post:candidate ratio of 1:3 in order of merit within each category; the final ratio will be decided by AVNL management based on the number of qualifying candidates.
  • Names of candidates shortlisted for CBT, Interview, or Trade Test, and final selections, will be notified on the AVNL website.

AVNL Recruitment 2026: Test Centres

The CBT will be held at: Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Jabalpur, Nagpur, Pune, Mumbai, New Delhi, Kolkata, and Kanpur. Candidates must indicate their preferred test centre in the online application form. AVNL reserves the right to modify, add, or cancel test centres depending on the number of eligible applicants; affected candidates will be assigned a new centre.
