How to Apply for AVNL Recruitment 2026

Step 1: Registration

  1. Visit the AVNL website and click the "Careers" tab at avnl.co.in
  2. Go to Career - "Register"
  3. Fill in Post name, Post Code (auto-selected), Name, Mobile Number, and Email ID
  4. Generate OTP, enter Captcha, and submit
  5. Enter the OTP received
  6. Accept Terms & Conditions via the "I Agree" checkbox, then click re-verify
  7. Select the checkboxes confirming entered values are correct, enter Captcha for re-verification, and submit registration details
  8. Receive the Registration Number, Login ID, and Password on the registered Email/Mobile

Step 2: Filling the Application Form & Fee Payment

  1. Click "Go to Application" or log in again with the Login ID and Password
  2. Fill in the complete application form
  3. Upload photograph, signature, and required documents (DOB proof, Proof of Educational Qualification, Category Certificate, Apprenticeship Training Certificate, PwBD/Ex-Servicemen proof, if applicable)
  4. Preview the application form before submission
  5. Edit details if required (Name, Post Applied, Email ID, and Mobile Number cannot be changed once submitted)
  6. Submit the application by clicking "I Agree" and entering the Captcha

Step 3: Fee Payment

  1. Choose the payment mode and proceed to the Payment Gateway
  2. Do not refresh or navigate back during payment
  3. Verify fee details and pay the application fee online
  4. On successful payment confirmation, you will be redirected back to the submitted application form
  5. Download the Application/Registration form for your records

No document is required to be sent to AVNL by post; the downloaded application slip should be retained by the candidate for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Selection of Option for ALL Units wherever a post is available is mandatory to complete the application.
  • Candidates should necessarily upload all required documents while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates are advised to apply for one post; in case of a clash in CBT dates, the candidate must choose one post/trade to appear for.
  • The category once filled in the online application form cannot be changed.
  • All computation of age, experience, and qualification requirements will be done with reference to the closing date of online registration.
  • Where a qualifying degree does not mention the required specialization, candidates must submit a certificate from their University/Institution at the time of Interview/Trade Test clearly stating their specialization.
  • Assistive devices/scribes for PwD candidates are allowed at the exam centre, subject to prior permission obtained by emailing [email protected].
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment can be instituted only in Chennai; courts/tribunals/forums at Chennai have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • AVNL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or enlarge the number of vacancies at any time without notice.
  • Selected candidates are subject to verification of educational/technical qualifications, category/disability certificate, experience certificate, and character & antecedents, and must be declared "Medically Fit" by a competent authority.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • For any issues related to online application submission or fee payment, contact the Help Desk (via the Help Desk tab on the application portal) at 022-61087565, Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM.

Bank of India Credit Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for the BOI Credit Officer Bharti 2026 will be through an Online Examination and/or Personal Interview, depending on the number of applicants. If both stages are conducted, the weightage will be 70:30 between the Online Examination and Interview.

  1. Scrutiny of Eligibility: Shortlisting based on documents uploaded at registration.

  3. Personal Interview: 100 marks, conducted for candidates shortlisted based on merit.
  4. Final Merit List: Prepared based on combined scores of Online Examination and Interview.

The minimum qualifying marks in each test is 35% for General/EWS candidates, with a 5% relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates. There is a penalty of one-fourth marks for each wrong answer in the objective test.

HPCL Apprentice Educational Qualification and Eligibility

  • Engineering Graduation in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation streams, recognized by the Board of Technical Education/UGC/AICTE or equivalent authority.

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Only candidates registered and approved on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0) portal and by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) will be considered.
  • Candidates with an existing apprenticeship contract with any other organization on the NATS portal are not eligible to apply.

HPCL Apprentice Selection Process

  1. Applications are screened based on merit percentage as per eligibility criteria and the number of training slots notified.

  3. Shortlisted candidates are called for document/certificate verification in a ratio of 1:5 against notified training slots, communicated via registered email. No TA/DA is paid for the verification process.
  4. A merit list is prepared based on candidates who report for verification and are found suitable.
  5. Selected candidates must accept a tri-partite apprenticeship contract on the NATS website and submit a medical certificate and undergo police verification.

How to Apply Online for HPCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Register on the Apprentice Application portal at jobs.hpcl.co.in/Recruit_New/recruitlogin.jsp using the "Sign up for New Registration" option.
  2. Login credentials will be sent to the registered email ID by the HPCL Apprentice Team.
  3. Sign in using the received email ID and password.
  4. Select the Engineering Branch from the dropdown as per the branches mentioned in the advertisement.
  5. Fill in Personal Details and click "Validate your details."
  6. Click "Save & Next" to proceed to Contact Details, including correspondence and permanent address.

  8. Validate details and proceed to Qualification Details.

  • HPCL does not guarantee permanent or temporary employment after successful completion of apprenticeship.
  • Apprentices who complete the training successfully will receive relaxation/preference in future recruitment norms in two stages: age relaxation to the extent of the apprenticeship period (not exceeding one year), and an additional 5% grace marks in the Computer Based Test (CBT) for shortlisting in subsequent recruitment.
  • Furnishing wrong or false information will lead to disqualification, even after engagement.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Apprentices will be placed for training at their preferred state, but may be assigned any training location within that state as per requirement/availability.
  • No hard copy of the application form needs to be submitted to HPCL.
  • All communication will be sent via the registered email ID/mobile number; applications with pseudo/fake email IDs will attract action under the law.
  • HPCL reserves the right to raise minimum eligibility standards, modify the selection process, and change the number of vacancies without prior notice.

The Indian Air Force has released the recruitment notification for Agniveervayu (Musician) Intake 01/2027, inviting unmarried Indian male and female candidates from all districts of all states and Union Territories to join the Indian Air Force as part of the Air Force Band. Online registration opens on 20 July 2026, and the pre-registered recruitment rally will be held from 31 August 2026 to 09 September 2026 at two venues: 2 ASC, Air Force Station New Delhi, and 7 ASC, Bengaluru. Candidates must have passed Matriculation/10th along with proficiency in playing a musical instrument. This article covers eligibility, important dates, musical proficiency requirements, salary, application fee, selection process and the complete application procedure.

IAF Agniveervayu Musician: Vacancy Details

Eligibility Criteria for IAF Agniveervayu Musician Recruitment 2026

Nationality

Open to Indian candidates from all districts of all States and all Union Territories of India.

Educational Qualification

Passed Matriculation/10th or equivalent with minimum pass marks from any Central, State or Union Territory Government recognised School/Board, as on the date of registration.

Marital Status

Only unmarried male and female candidates are eligible. Candidates must undertake not to marry during the four-year engagement period; violation leads to dismissal from service. Female candidates must additionally undertake not to become pregnant during the engagement period.

Musical Proficiency Requirements

Musical ability is a mandatory qualifying requirement in addition to the educational qualification.

  • Candidates must have proficiency in music with accuracy in tempo and pitch, and must be able to sing one complete song.
  • Candidates must be able to perform one preparatory tune and demonstrate knowledge of a notation system (Staff notation, Tablature, Tonic Solfa, Hindustani, or Carnatic).
  • Candidates must be able to tune individual instruments (where applicable) and match unknown notes on vocal or instruments.
  • Candidates must have proficiency in playing at least one instrument from List A or List B below. It is desirable (though not mandatory) to have proficiency in two instruments - one from each list.
List A List B
Concert Flute / Piccolo Keyboard / Organ / Piano
Oboe Guitar (Acoustic / Lead / Bass)
Clarinet in Eb / Bb Violin, Viola, String Bass
Saxophone in Eb / Bb Percussion / Drums (Acoustic / Electronic)
French Horn in F / Bb All Indian Classical Instruments
Trumpet in Eb / C / Bb  
Trombone in Bb / G  
Baritone  
Euphonium  
Bass / Tuba in Eb / Bb  

Musical Experience Certificate

Candidates must possess any one of the following:

  • Grade 5th or equivalent (or above) in one instrument from a recognised music institute such as TCL, RSM, KM Music Conservatory Bangalore, Bangalore School of Music, TSM, GMI, or Berklee School of Music, OR
  • A Diploma or equivalent in music for candidates performing Hindustani or Carnatic Classical Music from any recognised university, OR
  • Certificate of participation/awards presented at various events (applicable for candidates performing on blowing instruments with staff notation as per the educational QRs).

Age Limit

Criterion Detail
Date of Birth Block Born between 01 January 2005 and 01 July 2009 (both dates inclusive)
Upper Age Limit at Enrolment 22 years (if a candidate clears all stages of selection)

No separate age relaxation categories are specified in this notification.

Mandatory Medical Standards

Parameter Standard
Height (Male) Minimum 162 cms
Height (Female) Minimum 152 cms (147 cms for North East/hilly regions of Uttarakhand ethnicity; 150 cms for Lakshadweep ethnicity, with domicile certificate)
Weight Proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF
Chest (Male) Minimum circumference 77 cms; minimum expansion 5 cms
Chest (Female) Well proportioned; minimum expansion 5 cms
Hearing Able to hear forced whisper from 6 metres, each ear separately
Dental Minimum 14 dental points; healthy gums; dental implants not awarded points; fixed/removable orthodontic appliances - unfit
Visual Acuity 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye
Refractive Error Limits Hypermetropia +2.0D; Myopia -1D; including ±0.50D Astigmatism
Colour Vision CP-II

Candidates with a history of LASIK/PRK surgery will not be accepted. Body tattoos are permitted only on the inner forearm, back (dorsal) of the hand, or as per tribal custom; offensive/obscene/indecent tattoos anywhere on the body are disqualifying. Consumption, possession, storage or distribution of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances is a reject criterion, and the IAF follows a zero-tolerance policy on alcoholism and substance abuse.

Salary and Pay Package

Agniveervayu (Musician) will be paid an Agniveer package of ₹30,000 per month in the first year, with a fixed yearly increment, along with Risk and Hardship allowances, Dress and Travel allowances, and perks such as ration, clothing, accommodation, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per existing rules.

Seva Nidhi Package (Year-wise Contribution)

Year Customised Package (Monthly) In Hand (70%) Contribution to Agniveer Corpus Fund (30%) Matching Contribution by GoI
1st Year ₹30,000 ₹21,000 ₹9,000 ₹9,000
2nd Year ₹33,000 ₹23,100 ₹9,900 ₹9,900
3rd Year ₹36,500 ₹25,550 ₹10,950 ₹10,950
4th Year ₹40,000 ₹28,000 ₹12,000 ₹12,000

Total contribution to the Agniveer Corpus Fund after four years is approximately ₹5.02 lakh from the Agniveervayu's own contribution, matched by approximately ₹5.02 lakh from the Government of India. On exit after four years, this totals approximately ₹10.04 lakh as the Seva Nidhi package (excluding interest). There is no Provident Fund contribution requirement, and no gratuity or pensionary benefits are applicable.

Agniveervayu will also be provided non-contributory Life Insurance cover of ₹48 lakh for the duration of the four-year engagement period.

Application Fee

Category Fee
All Candidates ₹100 plus 18% GST (non-refundable)

Application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and cannot be carried forward to any other recruitment or selection process.

Selection Process

Selection for Agniveervayu (Musician) Intake 01/2027 involves the following stages, conducted in sequence:

  1. Verification of Eligibility Documents - original or DigiLocker-verified educational certificates and other applicable documents are scrutinised at the rally venue before the Physical Fitness Test.
  2. Physical Fitness Test (PFT-I) - 1.6 km run: within 7 minutes for male candidates, within 8 minutes for female candidates.
  3. Physical Fitness Test (PFT-II) - conducted after 10 minutes of recuperation:
    • Male candidates: 10 push-ups (1 minute), 10 sit-ups (1 minute), 20 squats (1 minute), with rest breaks between each exercise.
    • Female candidates: 10 sit-ups (1 minute 30 seconds), 15 squats (1 minute), with rest breaks between exercises.
  4. English Written Test - objective type, 30 questions, 30 minutes duration, based on Matriculation/10th CBSE syllabus. Candidates must qualify this test. Answers are marked on an OMR sheet, and results are declared the same day.
  5. Music Proficiency Test (MPT) - candidates who qualify the English written test undergo a proficiency test in playing musical instruments, conducted individually or in groups.
  6. Medical Examination - conducted in September 2026 at 11 AFH, Hindon and SMC, AF Station Jalahalli, including blood, urine, biochemistry, chest X-ray, ECG, and (for female candidates) ultrasonography of the lower abdomen and pelvis.

Marking Pattern for English Written Test

  • 1 mark for every correct answer.
  • 0 marks for an unattempted question.
  • 0 marks if more than one answer is given for a question.
  • No negative marking for a wrong answer.

Candidates declared medically unfit may apply for an Appeal Medical Board (AMB) by depositing ₹40 through e-MRO/MRO, within three working days of the medical examination.

SBI BMO Eligibility Criteria 2026: Qualification, Age & Experience

Candidates often ask what qualification is required for the SBI Medical Officer post - the answer is an MBBS degree from an NMC/State Medical Council-approved institution, with a postgraduate diploma or MD/MS degree preferred. Age and experience are both reckoned as on the cut-off date of 31 May 2026.

Educational Qualification:

  • Mandatory: MBBS from a recognized university/college approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council.
  • Preferred: Post Graduate Diploma OR Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS or equivalent).

Work Experience (post-basic qualification, as on 31.05.2026):

  • Candidates with only an MBBS degree need a minimum of 5 years' experience as a General Practitioner, counted from the date of NMC/State Medical Council registration.
  • Candidates with a postgraduate degree need a minimum of 3 years' experience as a General Practitioner from the date of registration.
  • Internship experience and teaching/training experience will not be counted toward this eligibility requirement.

Age Limit (as on 31.05.2026): Maximum age is 35 years for unreserved candidates.

SBI BMO Selection Process 2026

The selection process for the SBI Bank Medical Officer post involves three stages - an Online Written Test, an Interview, and a Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) - with the final merit list based on 70% weightage to the written test and 30% to the interview. Candidates wondering how marks are normalized can note that the Bank combines scores from both stages using this 70:30 ratio before preparing the final merit list, circle-wise and category-wise.

  1. Online Written Test - Tentatively scheduled for August 2026 across multiple centres nationwide; call letters will be issued via the Bank's website, SMS, and email.
  2. Shortlisting - Based on Professional Knowledge cut-off marks, plus minimum qualifying marks in General Aptitude sections.
  3. Interview - Carries 100 marks; conducted for a category-wise adequate number of shortlisted candidates.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) - Conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining; candidates with 10th/12th mark sheets showing the relevant local language as a subject are exempted.
  5. Final Result & Wait List - A circle-wise and category-wise wait list valid for one year (or until a fresh advertisement, whichever is earlier) is maintained for non-joining or termination cases.

  8. Pay the application fee via Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking.

SBI BMO Salary 2026: Pay Scale & Perks

Selected candidates will be placed in the Middle Management Grade Scale-II (MMGS-II) with a basic pay structure of ₹64,820-2340/1-67,160-2680/10-93,960. In addition to basic pay, officers receive DA, HRA, CCA, Provident Fund, NPS contribution, Leave Fare Concession (LFC), and medical facilities as per Bank rules.

  • Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA): 20% of Basic Pay.
  • Higher Start: One increment for a postgraduate diploma; two increments for MD/MS or equivalent.
  • Private Practice: Not permitted for BMOs.
  • Conference Allowance: One local and one national medical conference may be permitted, subject to approval.

Documents Required for SBI BMO Application

Troubleshooting & Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

Many candidates lose out on the SBI BMO opportunity due to avoidable errors rather than ineligibility, so being aware of these common pitfalls can save your application from rejection.

  • Don't wait till the last day (21 July 2026) to register - heavy website traffic near the deadline frequently causes login failures and incomplete submissions.
  • Double-check your Circle/Office choice before final submission - you can apply for only one Circle, and switching later is not permitted.
  • Verify photo and signature specifications carefully (photograph: 20-50 KB, 200×230 pixels; signature: 10-20 KB, 140×60 pixels) to avoid application rejection due to unclear images.
  • Count only post-internship experience - internship, teaching, and training experience do not qualify toward the 5-year (MBBS) or 3-year (PG) experience requirement.
  • Keep your OBC non-creamy layer certificate dated correctly - it must be issued between 01.04.2026 and the date of interview; older certificates will not be accepted.
  • Don't submit multiple applications - only your last completed application is considered valid, and fees paid for earlier attempts are forfeited.
  • Ensure your mobile number and email remain active until the final result is declared, since all call letters and updates are sent only electronically.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

Sarkari Job Find - Filter by Qualification & State

Not every sarkari job requires a degree. Use the qualification and state filters below to sarkari job find openings that actually match your eligibility, instead of scrolling through listings you don't qualify for.

Sarkari Job for 10th Pass / 12th Pass

Several high-volume recruiters - including Railways (Group D), SSC (MTS, GD), and state police departments - recruit primarily at the 10th pass and 12th pass level. Browse these openings on our 10th & 12th Pass Jobs page.

Sarkari Job for Graduates & Postgraduates

Graduate and postgraduate-level sarkari jobs include SSC CGL, Bank PO, UPSC Civil Services, and various state PCS exams. See qualification-matched listings on our Graduate Jobs page.

State-Wise Sarkari Bharat Job (Bihar, UP, Tamil Nadu, and more)

State government recruitment is listed separately by state, since eligibility and domicile rules vary. Find your state's current openings via our State Government Jobs directory.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How can I get instant Sarkari Job Alert notifications?

You can bookmark this page for daily updates, or subscribe to OnlyJobs's notification service to receive a Sarkari Job Alert as soon as a new central or state vacancy is announced.

Where can I check the latest Bharat Job Result 2026?

All declared results - including written exam results, merit lists, and interview outcomes - are listed in the Results section of this page, updated as soon as departments release official Bharat Job Result notices.

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

FAQs - Forest Department Recruitment 2026

Q1: What is the latest forest department recruitment 2026?

The latest notifications include Forest Guard, Forester, Range Forest Officer, and Group C forest posts released by state forest departments, PSCs, and staff selection boards. Check the table above for live vacancies and last dates, updated daily.

Q2: What is the last date to apply for forest department recruitment 2026?

The application last date varies by state and recruiting body - it is listed against each notification in the table above under "Last Date to Apply." Always confirm the exact date on the official notification before applying.

Q3: What is the qualification for forest guard recruitment 2026?

Most Forest Guard and Field Guard posts require a 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board. Higher posts like Forester or Range Forest Officer typically need 12th pass, a graduate degree, or a degree in a science/forestry-related field.

Q4: Is there any age relaxation for ex-servicemen in forest department recruitment?

Yes. Jobs for ex-servicemen in the forest department usually come with reserved vacancies and additional age relaxation - typically 3 to 5 years beyond the standard age limit - along with relaxed physical standards in many states.

Q5: How can I apply online for forest department vacancy 2026?

Visit the official website of the respective state forest department or recruitment board, register with your basic details, fill in the application form, upload the required documents, pay the fee, and submit. Full step-by-step details are in the "How to Apply" section above.

Q6: Which states have active forest guard recruitment 2026 notifications?

Q7: What is the salary for forest guard and forest officer posts in 2026?

Forest Guard salary typically ranges from ₹28,000 to ₹35,000 gross per month under Pay Level 3, while Range Forest Officer and ACF posts range from ₹50,000 to ₹95,000 depending on pay level. Full breakdown is in the salary table above.

Yes, most states conduct a written exam covering General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, and Mathematics, followed by a Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and document verification before the final merit list is prepared.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released Advertisement No. 08/2026, inviting online applications for recruitment by selection to 13 posts spread across the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Ministry of Home Affairs, and Ministry of Law and Justice. The posts include Assistant Soil Chemist, Prosecutor (SFIO), six specialities of Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor, Deputy Assistant Director (Entomology), Entomologist (CCCO), Junior Scientific Officer (Toxicology) and Superintendent (Legal). Online applications open on 11 July 2026 and the closing date is 31 July 2026 at 1800 hrs. Selection to all posts is made through UPSC's interview-based recruitment-by-selection process, with a Recruitment Test in some cases. Candidates must apply through upsconline.nic.in/ora.

The document number is Advertisement No. 08/2026, and it lists vacancy numbers, reservation position, and post-specific eligibility for each of the 13 posts. Candidates are advised to read the full notification on the official UPSC website (upsc.gov.in) before applying, since the article below summarises the notification but does not replace it.

UPSC 08/2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality / Citizenship

A candidate must be either a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India. Candidates in the latter categories must hold a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.

Assistant Soil Chemist Master's Degree in Agriculture or Agricultural Chemistry with specialisation in Soil Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry or Soil Science from a recognised University/Institute 3 years' experience in Soil and Water analysis in a Central/State Government, UT, autonomous/statutory organisation, PSU, University or recognised research institution
Prosecutor (SFIO) Graduate in any discipline plus LLB from a recognised University/Institute; OR Integrated 5-year Law degree from a recognised University/Institute 1 year (for regular LLB route) or 2 years (for integrated law degree route) experience handling litigation and court matters / administration of law in a Government organisation

Deputy Assistant Director (Entomology) Master's Degree in Zoology with Entomology, or Master's Degree in Public Health Entomology, from a recognised University/Institute 3 years' experience in teaching and/or research and/or control in Medical Entomology, Public Health Entomology or Vector Borne Diseases under a Central/State Government body, autonomous/statutory organisation, PSU, University or recognised research institute

Superintendent (Legal) Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB) from a recognised University or an institution approved by the Central Government 2 years' experience as an Officer of the State Judicial Service, OR in the Legal Department of a State, OR as a Central Government servant in legal affairs, OR as an Advocate at the Bar

For every post, the notification states that qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC, for reasons recorded in writing, in the case of candidates who are otherwise well qualified. UPSC 08/2026 Selection Process

  • Selection is made by the Union Public Service Commission through Recruitment by Selection, which may involve a Recruitment Test (RT) or Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) followed by an interview, or interview only, depending on the post - the notification does not specify which mode applies to each individual post beyond noting that a Recruitment Test may form part of the selection process.
  • Where a Recruitment Test forms part of selection, candidates must clear the minimum level of suitability at both the RT stage and the interview stage for their respective category.
  • The minimum level of suitability in interview, irrespective of whether selection is by interview alone or RT plus interview, is: UR – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PH – 40 marks, out of a total of 100 interview marks.
  • Where the number of applications is large, UPSC may apply shortlisting criteria such as desirable qualifications, higher educational qualifications, higher relevant experience, or a Recruitment Test, to restrict the number of candidates called for interview.
  • Recruitment Test / Combined Recruitment Test, where held, is ordinarily conducted at: Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam. The list of centres is subject to change and will be notified on the Commission's website.
  • Candidature at every stage remains provisional, subject to the candidate satisfying all prescribed eligibility conditions.

Documents Required for UPSC Advt 08/2026

  • Matriculation/10th Standard certificate or equivalent mark sheet indicating date of birth
  • Degree/Diploma certificate (or provisional certificate with all mark sheets) as proof of educational qualification claimed
  • Order/letter for any equivalent educational qualification claimed, naming the authority and its number/date
  • Experience certificate(s) in the prescribed proforma from the Head of the concerned Organisation/Department, mentioning duration, basic pay/consolidated pay and nature of duties
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma for SC/ST/OBC candidates seeking reservation
  • Non-creamy-layer declaration for OBC candidates, in addition to the OBC certificate
  • Certificate of Disability in the prescribed proforma, issued by a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government, for PwBD candidates
  • Documents relating to change of name, if applicable (marriage/divorce/other, as specified in the notification)
  • Age relaxation certificates for Ex-Servicemen, Commissioned Officers, Central/UT Government employees, or other special provisions, as applicable
  • Certificates for any claim of Professional Registration, Language, Publications, NET, GATE, Conference or Internship
  • Declaration by candidates already in regular Government service that they have informed their Head of Office/Department of having applied

Documents such as pay slips, resumes, appointment letters, relieving letters, or unsigned experience certificates must not be uploaded in the Document Upload Module. If any document is in a language other than Hindi or English, an attested/notarised transcript must be submitted.

How to Apply for UPSC Advertisement No. 08/2026

  1. Visit the UPSC Online Application Portal at upsconline.nic.in/ora.
  2. Complete Account Creation on the portal, if not already registered.
  3. Complete the Universal Registration module to generate a Universal Registration Number (URN), which is common across all UPSC recruitments and remains constant for the candidate.
  4. Fill the Common Application Form (CAF), including uploading a photograph and capturing a live photograph as instructed on the portal.
  5. Upload signature: sign three times on plain white paper in black ink and upload the image as per the portal's instructions.
  6. Fill the fourth, post/vacancy-specific module for the desired post, available only during the notified application window.
  7. Upload all supporting documents against each claim (date of birth, category, educational qualification, experience, disability, etc.) as separate PDF files.
  8. Pay the prescribed application fee online, if applicable to your category.
  9. Review all entries carefully - applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction or alteration is permitted after submission.
  10. Submit the application and download/print the finally submitted Online Recruitment Application for your own records.

Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the closing date rather than waiting until the last day, and to keep their Aadhaar Card ready as the preferred ID document for verification.

Important Instructions

  • All correspondence from UPSC will be made through the registered e-mail ID only, including interview schedules and requirements for submission of certificate copies - candidates must enter a correct, active e-mail address.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) can apply for any post listed as "suitable" for their category, even if that specific post is not reserved for PwBD; such candidates are considered by the general standard of merit unless the post carries a PwBD reservation.
  • Only persons with 40% or more of the relevant disability are eligible for the benefit of reservation and other relaxations under PwBD provisions.
  • Where sufficient PwBD candidates are not available for posts exclusively reserved and identified suitable for them, the required years of experience (not the nature of experience) may be relaxed by up to 50%.
  • Scribe facility is available to PwBD candidates in the categories of blindness, both-arms-affected locomotor disability, and cerebral palsy on request; for other categories, a certificate of physical limitation to write from a Government Chief Medical Officer/Civil Surgeon/Medical Superintendent is required.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, programmable devices, storage media, cameras, Bluetooth devices, and similar equipment are strictly banned inside the examination/interview hall, even in switched-off mode.
  • Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue/interview hall.
  • Furnishing false particulars, suppressing material information, tampering with documents, or using unfair means can lead to disqualification and debarment from UPSC examinations and Central Government employment.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • Summoning for interview does not guarantee selection; appointment orders are issued by the respective Ministry after selection.

IPL Recruitment 2026: Remuneration by Grade

Remuneration for Individual Consultants is decided within the corresponding band, based on years of post-qualification relevant experience. Final remuneration for a selected candidate depends on expectations, experience, and expertise, and the decision of IPL is final and binding.

Grade Code Grade Post-Qualification Relevant Experience Indicative Age Remuneration Range (₹ per month)
YP Young Professional 1 year 32 ₹70,000
I Consultant (Grade I) 3–8 years 45 ₹80,000 – ₹1,45,000
II Consultant (Grade II) 8–15 years 50 ₹1,45,000 – ₹2,65,000
III Senior Consultant 15 years and above 62 ₹2,65,000 – ₹3,30,000

Consultants will also be allowed to undertake tours as required by their duties, for which TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation shall be paid or reimbursed as per Company policy.

IPL Recruitment 2026 Selection Procedure

  • Selection is done by way of Interview. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview.
  • IPL reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates for interview after preliminary screening/shortlisting, with reference to qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirement.
  • IPL will call only those candidates who match the requirements for the specific grade, position, and IC Code indicated in the application form. Applying for a higher grade does not automatically make the applicant eligible for a lower grade.
  • Applicants must apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code.
  • Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend an interview in Delhi or in online mode, as decided by IPL in its absolute discretion. IPL will not reimburse any expenditure incurred by an applicant for appearing at the interview.
  • IPL reserves the right to appoint none, one, or more Individual Consultants against any IC Code.

Period and Nature of Engagement

Individual Consultants will be engaged for a fixed period of two years, which may be extended by one year at a time, up to a maximum tenure of five years (2+1+1+1 years), for providing services on specific projects as per requirement. Continuation beyond the first and subsequent years is contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on defined Key Performance Indicators.

Engagement is on a Contractual and Full-Time basis, during which the selected candidate is not allowed to take up appointment/engagement/assignment anywhere else.

Medical Standard

The prescribed medical standard is A-2, requiring distant vision 6/9, 6/9 (without glasses) and near vision Sn 0.6, 0.6 (without glasses), along with normal colour vision, binocular vision, night vision, and myopic vision. Candidates who have undergone Lasik or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible for this post.

RRB Section Controller Salary 2026

The post of Section Controller carries Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (7th CPC) with an initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400 per month. Detailed break-up of allowances (DA, HRA, TA etc.) is not specified in the notification.

Fee payment must be made online only (net banking, debit/credit card, or UPI) by 16.08.2026.

RRB Section Controller Selection Process 2026

Selection for the post of Section Controller involves the following stages:

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT): Single stage, 120 minutes, 100 questions, with negative marking of 1/3 mark per wrong answer
  2. Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT): Shortlisting to the extent of 8 times the vacancies; candidates must secure a minimum T-Score of 42 marks in each test battery to qualify; no negative marking
  3. Document Verification (DV): Shortlisting at 1:1 ratio of vacancies, based on 70% weightage to CBT and 30% weightage to CBAT
  4. Medical Examination: As per Medical Standard A-2

The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), Ministry of Law & Justice, Government of India, has issued Vacancy Circular No. F.301-Ad(ATD)/DR/2026-27 inviting online applications from Indian nationals for filling up existing and anticipated vacancies in the cadres of Senior Private Secretary and Private Secretary (both Group B Gazetted) at various Benches of ITAT across the country. A total of 42 posts are notified - 22 Senior Private Secretary and 20 Private Secretary. Selection is through a Written Examination, Skill Test and Personal Interview. This article covers the ITAT Private Secretary Recruitment 2026-27 vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, pay scale, exam pattern, qualifying marks and how to apply online, based strictly on the official Vacancy Circular.

  • For all candidates, age for applying to either post shall not exceed 35 years.
  • Standard age relaxation, as per instructions/orders issued by the Central Government from time to time, is applicable for Government servants and SC/ST/OBC candidates.
  • The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the 30th day from the date of publication of the advertisement in "Employment News."
  • A separate crucial date consideration applies for candidates residing in Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, the Union Territory of Ladakh, the Lahaul & Spiti district and Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba district of Himachal Pradesh, the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir, and the Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep, as per the notification.

ITAT Selection Process 2026-27

Recruitment is through a Written Examination, Skill Test, followed by a Personal Interview.

Written Examination and Skill Test Centres

The written examination and skill test will be conducted at 9 stations: Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore, Guwahati, Lucknow, Ahmedabad and Hyderabad. Candidates must opt for two centres of choice in order of preference. If a sufficient number of candidates is not received for a particular station, ITAT has the sole discretion to cancel that centre, and the candidate will be required to appear at the second centre chosen by them.

The overall merit list will be drawn on the basis of combined merit acquired in the Skill Test and the Personal Interview. Both the Written Examination papers and the Skill Test will be conducted in English medium only.

SC/ST candidates already in service of the Central/State Government, a Central/State Government Corporation, Public Sector Undertaking, Local Government Institute or Panchayat, etc., shall be reimbursed 2nd Class Ordinary/Sleeper Class railway fare or bus fare, on production of tickets as per Government of India guidelines, for appearing in the Skill Test and Personal Interview.

How to Apply for ITAT Recruitment 2026-27

  2. Register and fill in the online application form with personal, educational and category details

  5. Submit the application within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in "Employment News"
  6. Regularly check the registered email and the official ITAT website (https://www.itat.gov.in) for updates on admit cards, skill test/interview call letters and results, as all communication will be sent by email only

Applications must be submitted online only; no other mode of application is accepted as per the notification.

ITAT Recruitment Important Instructions 2026-27

  • Any physical correspondence, communication or queries from individual candidates regarding the Written Examination, Skill Test, Personal Interview or final result shall NOT be entertained by the office.
  • Admit cards, discrepancies in applications, call letters and results will be communicated to candidates through email only, at the address provided in the application; general notifications will also be uploaded on the official ITAT website.
  • Selected candidates shall be on probation for a period of 2 years from the date of joining the post.
  • Selected candidates shall be liable to be posted at any of the Benches of ITAT across the country.
  • All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Mumbai.
  • The decision of ITAT on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection, shall be final; no query or correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

IOCL Panipat Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

  • There is no written test for this recruitment.
  • Selection is based on percentage of marks (aggregate of all subjects across all years/semesters) obtained in the prescribed qualification, arranged in descending order, subject to meeting the notified eligibility criteria.
  • Preference is given to candidates applying for apprenticeship training for the first time.
  • In case of a tie in marks, the candidate senior in age (date of birth) is ranked higher; if the date of birth is also the same, higher marks in Matriculation are considered.
  • PwBD candidates who avail relaxation in eligibility qualification marks are considered against reserved seats in order of merit within the category, irrespective of their position in the overall select list.
  • Filling of seats is solely at the discretion of management based on candidate suitability; no claim arises if seats remain unfilled due to insufficient suitable candidates.
  • Shortlisted candidates are called for Document Verification based on merit list position and the number of seats in each Trade/Discipline.

NGEL Recruitment 2026: Eligibility

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions recognized and approved in India.
  • Age, experience and qualification will be computed with reference to the last date of receipt of online application.
  • Category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD) selected in the online application cannot be changed later, and no benefit of another category will be admissible afterward.

NGEL Educational Qualification & Experience

Assistant Engineer - RE (E-0 Grade)

  • Qualification: Fulltime Regular Diploma in Engineering (Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics/Electrical & Electronics/Instrumentation) from a State Technical Board or AICTE/UGC recognized institute, with pass marks.
  • Experience: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification site experience in the Power Sector (including training period, if any), in a Govt. Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Organization - of which at least 6 years must be in a 50 MW or more grid-connected Solar and/or Wind Project, in Operation and Maintenance/Asset Management.

Deputy General Manager - RE (E-6 Grade)

  • Qualification: Fulltime Graduate in Engineering (Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Electronics/Control & Instrumentation/Civil/Mechanical) with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized Indian University/Institute. SC, ST & PwBD candidates with passing marks are eligible to apply.
  • Experience: Minimum 12 years of post-qualification executive-cadre experience in the Power Sector (including training period, if any) - of which at least 10 years must be with a Renewable Energy Developer of Solar and/or Wind Projects, including a minimum of 2 years of site experience in a 50 MW or more grid-connected project in Construction/Erection/Commissioning.
  • Government/PSU candidates applying for the E-6 level post must additionally have a minimum of 2 years' experience in the pay scale of ₹80,000-₹2,20,000 (IDA E-5 Grade or above, effective 01-01-2017) or equivalent, within the 12 years of post-qualification executive experience.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Indian Army has released the official notification for the 68th Short Service Commission (Technical) Men course, commencing in April 2027. The recruitment is open to unmarried male engineering graduates and final-year engineering students in notified streams. Online applications can be submitted at www.joinindianarmy.nic.in. This article summarizes the eligibility criteria, vacancy details, important dates, selection process, salary structure, and application steps exactly as given in the official notification.

Queries related to allotment of centres, interview dates, merit list, or joining instructions are answered only through the "Feedback/Query" option on the official website; queries submitted less than 3 days before the application closing date are not entertained.

Indian Army SSC Tech 68 Men Vacancy Details (Stream-Wise)

A total of 350 vacancies (tentative, subject to change based on organizational requirements) have been notified across six core engineering streams:

S.No. Core Engineering Stream Vacancies
1 Civil 75
2 Computer Science 60
3 Electrical 33
4 Electronics 64

Total   350

Each core stream includes several AICTE-approved equivalent stream names (for example, "Civil" includes Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Architecture Engineering, and related disciplines). Candidates must apply under the stream that exactly matches their degree certificate/marksheet nomenclature — any mismatch between the stream name on the degree and the stream selected in the online application results in cancellation of candidature.

A candidate can apply for only one engineering stream/discipline; change of stream is not allowed at any stage of the selection process.
