Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or East African countries (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia) and Vietnam, with the intention of permanently settling in India, provided a certificate of eligibility has been issued by the Government of India (not required for Gorkha subjects of Nepal).

Marital Status

Open only to unmarried male candidates. Candidates must not marry until they complete the full training at the Officers Training Academy. Marrying during training or after applying (before joining) leads to cancellation/discharge.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 27 years as on 01 Apr 2027, i.e., born between 01 Apr 2000 and 31 Mar 2007 (both dates inclusive).

Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate (or equivalent) is accepted. No other document for age proof is accepted, and no request for change of recorded date of birth is considered later.

Minimum Physical Standards (Before Joining Training Academy)

Activity Minimum Standard (Officer Cadets – Men)
2.4 Km Run 10 minutes 30 seconds
Push-Up 40
Pull-Up 06
Sit-Up 30
Squats Two sets of 30 repetitions
Lunges Two sets of 10 repetitions
Swimming Basic knowledge of swimming required

Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have passed the required engineering degree, or are in the final year of an engineering degree course in a notified stream, are eligible to apply.
  • Final-year candidates must be able to submit proof of passing the engineering degree examination, along with marksheets of all semesters/years, by 01 April 2027, and produce the degree certificate within 12 weeks from the start of PCTA training.
  • Candidates whose final year/final semester result is declared after 29 March 2027 are not eligible to apply for this course.
  • Final-year candidates are provisionally allowed to appear for the SSB if their cumulative percentage of marks up to the 6th semester/3rd year (Engineering), 8th semester/4th year (B.Arch), or 2nd semester/1st year (M.Sc in a notified equivalent stream) is not below the approved cut-off percentage for their stream.
  • After final results are declared, the cumulative percentage up to the final semester/year must also not fall below the approved cut-off, or the candidature will be cancelled.
  • The degree must be from a university/institution recognized by an Act of Parliament/State Legislature or deemed university under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007, or IIIT Act 2024. Degrees from foreign universities are not accepted.

Selection Process

The Indian Army SSC (Tech)-68 Men selection follows this sequence:

Application > Shortlisting > SSB > Medical Examination > Merit List > Joining Letter

1. Shortlisting of Applications

Applications are shortlisted stream-wise based on the vacancy-to-call-up ratio and the cumulative percentage of marks obtained up to the final semester/year, without the Army being required to state a reason. The shortlisting cut-off percentage is expected to be published in the first week of September 2026.

2. Selection of SSB Centre and Dates

After shortlisting, candidates log in to the website to select their SSB dates and centre on a first-come, first-served basis. Once selected, the centre and date generally cannot be changed. This window is expected to open for two weeks in September 2026.

3. SSB Interview

  • Shortlisted candidates are called to one of four Selection Centres: Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka), and Jalandhar (Punjab).
  • The SSB is a two-stage process. Candidates who clear Stage-1 proceed to Stage-2; those who do not clear Stage-1 are sent back the same day.
  • The SSB interview lasts up to five days, likely held between October and December 2026.
  • Candidates recommended after Stage-2 undergo a medical examination.

4. Medical Examination

Medical standards and examination procedures are detailed on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in. The SSB medical examination is valid for 270 days from the Special Medical Board (SMB) date to the PCTA joining date. Candidates already declared "Medically Fit" in a prior SSB medical (within the 270-day validity relative to 01 Apr 2027) need not undergo the medical again.

5. Merit List

Qualifying the SSB interview alone does not confirm final selection. A stream-wise merit list is prepared based on SSB interview marks. In case of a tie in SSB marks, the older candidate is ranked higher; if age is also equal, the candidate with a higher percentage in the qualifying degree is ranked higher. Higher educational qualifications or past performance play no role in merit ranking.

Training Details

  • Training Academy: Officers Training Academy (OTA), Gaya, Bihar
  • Duration: 49 weeks, from April 2027 to March 2028
  • Stipend during training: ₹56,100 per month (equal to the starting pay in Level-10 of the pay matrix)
  • Rank on commissioning: Lieutenant, granted Short Service Commission on probation from the course start date or PCTA reporting date, whichever is later
  • Ante-date seniority: One year ante-date seniority is granted from the date of commission
  • Academic award: On successful completion of training, candidates are awarded a "Post Graduate Diploma in Military Studies & Defence Management" by Magadh University, Bodh Gaya
  • Marriage restriction: Not permitted to marry during training; violation leads to discharge and recovery of expenses
  • Cost of training recovery: If an Officer Cadet resigns/withdraws from training for reasons other than medical grounds, the cost of training (₹20,482.40 per week for the 01 Jul 2026–30 Jun 2027 period, as revised from time to time) must be refunded

Not specified in the official notification. The notification does not mention any application fee or fee-payment process for the SSC (Tech)-68 Men course. Candidates should refer to the "Apply Online" section on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in at the time of application for the most current information.

Documents Required for SSB Interview

Candidates must carry self-attested copies along with original documents to the Selection Centre. DigiLocker certificates are not accepted in place of originals unless accompanied by an authentication letter from the institution confirming only e-certificates were issued.

  • One signed printout of the application form with a self-attested photograph affixed
  • Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate (or equivalent) and marksheet — the only accepted proof of date of birth and parents' names
  • 12th class marksheet and certificate, or Diploma marksheet and certificate (for Diploma holders)
  • Engineering Degree/Provisional Degree certificate issued by a recognized university (Provisional Degree must not be more than 6 months old at the time of joining the Academy)
  • Marksheets of all semesters/years
  • Certificate from the university's Controller of Examination/Registrar regarding the CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula
  • Certificate confirming cumulative percentage up to the relevant semester/year (for final-year appearing candidates)
  • Certificate from the Principal/Head of Institution confirming the candidate is in the final year and the result will be declared by 01 April 2027
  • Declaration by final-year candidates that they will submit proof of passing along with all marksheets by 01 April 2027
  • Documents related to civil/character verification
  • An affidavit is required if there is any variation between the candidate's name/parents' names on educational documents and the online application

How to Apply for Indian Army SSC Tech 68 Men Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  2. Click on "Officer Entry Application/Login," then click "Registration" (skip this step if already registered on the portal).
  3. Fill the online registration form after carefully reading the instructions. Aadhaar number and matriculation certificate details are mandatory for registration.
  4. After registering, click "Apply Online" under the Dashboard.
  5. On the "Officers Selection – Eligibility" page, click "Apply" against the Short Service Commission Technical Course.
  6. Fill in the Application Form across all sections: personal information, communication details, education details, and previous SSB details (if any). Click "Save & Continue" after each section.
  7. Review all entries on the "Summary of your information" page.
  8. Click "Submit" only after confirming all details are correct.
  9. Take two printouts of the application (with roll number) 30 minutes after the final closure of the online application on the last day.

Important: No changes can be made to the submitted application after the closing date, and no representation on this will be entertained.

Important Instructions to Note

  • Any mismatch between the engineering stream on the degree certificate/marksheet and the stream selected in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Any variation in the candidate's name or parents' names between educational documents and the application requires an affidavit explaining the variation.
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted to marks using the formula adopted by the candidate's own university before filling in "Marks obtained in Graduation."
  • Only one online application is allowed per candidate; multiple applications result in cancellation.
  • Candidates already serving in the Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer in writing about applying, and their application must be countersigned by the Commanding Officer.
  • Candidates who have ever been debarred by UPSC from any examination are not eligible.
  • Candidates arrested, convicted by a criminal court, or involved in a criminal case are not eligible; discovery of such facts at any stage leads to cancellation/withdrawal.
  • Candidates withdrawn from NDA, IMA, OTA, Naval Academy, Air Force Academy, or any service training academy on disciplinary grounds are not eligible to apply.
  • Requests for change of SSB interview date or centre will not be entertained or replied to.
  • The notification is published in Hindi and English; in case of any discrepancy, the English version prevails.

Travelling Allowance for SSB Interview

Candidates appearing for the SSB interview for the first time for this type of commission are entitled to AC-3 Tier railway fare (or equivalent bus fare, including reservation/sleeper charges) within Indian limits, for to-and-fro travel. Candidates reappearing for the same type of commission are not entitled to travelling allowance on subsequent occasions.

CWC Young Professional Roles and Responsibilities

Post Code 01: Young Professional (Learning & Development)

  • Supporting the formulation and execution of the Annual Training and Capacity Building Plan and conducting Training Needs Analysis (TNA).
  • Assisting in designing functional, behavioral, and leadership development programs, and coordinating with external training institutes and consultants.
  • Managing end-to-end training logistics, maintaining the Training Calendar, and preparing training reports and dashboards.
  • Supporting implementation of Learning Management Systems/e-learning platforms, including the iGOT Karmayogi Portal.
  • Analyzing training feedback and effectiveness, and preparing periodic reports on Learning & Development outcomes and ROI.

Post Code 02: Young Professional (PCS Marketing)

  • Identifying new business opportunities and clients for pest control services, and supporting preparation of proposals, tenders, and quotations.
  • Conducting market surveys and competitor analysis, and maintaining liaison with existing clients.
  • Coordinating with Field units/Technical Teams to achieve marketing targets and revenue goals.
  • Maintaining records of tenders participated in, awarded, and pending, and supporting timely billing and documentation.
  • Supporting digital and offline marketing initiatives for PCS (Pest Control Services).

Post Code 03: Young Professional (Marketing & Business Development) - Hyderabad

  • Conducting market research to identify stakeholders, trends, and competitors relevant to CWC's warehousing and logistics services.
  • Engaging with farmers, FPOs, FPCs, banks, and trading platforms for post-harvest warehousing, as well as bulk procurers, e-commerce operators, and 3PL/4PL/5PL operators.
  • Engaging with EXIM and Private Container Train Operator (PCTO) stakeholders including shipping lines, freight forwarders, Customs, and Indian Railways.
  • Developing and implementing strategies to promote CWC's business verticals and expand its customer base.
  • Creating marketing materials and reaching stakeholders through door-to-door marketing, social media, WhatsApp, and cold calling.

Post Code 04: Young Professional (Marketing & Business Development) - Jaipur

  • Organizing training sessions, workshops, and field visits at CWC warehouses to educate stakeholders about CWC's services.
  • Collecting stakeholder feedback and communicating it to CWC management for continuous improvement.
  • Identifying areas for market expansion and recommending business development strategies for new regions.
  • Setting and tracking sales targets for the respective business vertical, and preparing regular activity reports.
  • Working in coordination with the Regional Marketing Head and Regional Manager of the region, and staying updated on CWC/GoI policies and schemes relevant to e-commerce, logistics, and supply chain operations.

Selection Process

Selection for CCI Recruitment 2026 will be made through a Computer Based Test followed by Document Verification.

  • The written test will consist of 120 objective-type MCQs to be completed in 120 minutes.
  • 1 mark will be awarded for each correct answer, with 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer.
  • The test covers General English, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Knowledge, Computer Proficiency (post-wise), and Subject Knowledge specific to the post.

Minimum qualifying percentage for the Computer Based Test is as follows:

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage

Examinations will be conducted in Mumbai/Navi Mumbai, Hyderabad, New Delhi, Chennai, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Patna, and Jaipur.

Candidates must upload scanned copies of the following documents at the time of online application:

  • Recent scanned signature
  • 10th class certificate/mark sheet
  • 12th class certificate/mark sheet
  • Essential qualification degree certificate
  • Additional qualification degree certificate (if any)
  • Experience certificate (if applicable)

Original documents along with photocopies will be required at the time of document verification.

  1. Visit the official website www.cotcorp.org.in and click on the "Recruitment" link.
  2. Read the advertisement carefully and verify eligibility for the post.
  3. Click "Enter" and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and other required details.
  4. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Preview the application form and read the declaration before submission.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee/intimation charges through the online payment gateway.
  7. Take a printout of the application form and the fee payment receipt for future reference.

Note: The online application, once submitted, cannot be altered or withdrawn under any circumstances. Candidates can apply for only one post; multiple applications will be summarily rejected.

  • The Corporation reserves the right to fill or not fill any of the advertised posts without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates already employed with Government/Semi-Government/PSU organizations must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of document verification.
  • Category, once selected in the application form, cannot be changed at any later stage.
  • No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the written test or document verification.

What Is the SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026?

Before downloading your admit card, it helps to understand exactly what this document is and why it matters for the recruitment process. The SBI CBO Interview Call Letter is the official admission ticket that confirms a candidate has cleared the earlier stages and is now eligible to appear for the personal interview round.

The interview call letter is a mandatory document for the SBI CBO Recruitment 2026 drive, which is being conducted to fill 2,050 vacancies for the Circle Based Officer post across various states and language zones. Without this call letter, candidates will not be permitted entry into the interview venue, so downloading and verifying it well in advance is essential.

Carrying the correct set of documents is non-negotiable for interview-day entry. This section lists everything you must bring along.

  • A valid original photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID, etc.)
  • Original and photocopies of educational certificates and mark sheets

Candidates should keep all documents organized in a single folder to avoid last-minute confusion at the venue.

SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

Understanding how your final selection is calculated helps you prepare strategically for the interview. This section explains the complete selection methodology for SBI CBO 2026.

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

  1. Online Examination - The first screening stage testing candidates' aptitude and knowledge.
  2. Screening/Shortlisting - Candidates are shortlisted based on online exam performance for the interview stage.
  3. Interview - Worth 50 marks, assessing banking awareness, professional knowledge, and communication skills.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the regional/local language relevant to their applied state or circle.

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

  • Online Examination: 75% weightage
  • Interview: 25% weightage

This means strong performance in the online exam significantly boosts your overall chances, but a good interview score remains essential for the final cutoff.

  2. Preliminary Result – Declared in September/October 2026.
  3. Online Main Examination – Tentatively in November 2026; scores from this stage alone are used for interview shortlisting and final merit.

The Preliminary Exam for IT Officer, Agricultural Field Officer, HR/Personnel Officer, and Marketing Officer consists of 100 questions for 125 marks across English Language, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, and Professional Knowledge, to be completed in 80 minutes. The Main Exam for the same posts carries 150 objective questions for 200 marks plus a Descriptive Paper of 25 marks, totaling 225 marks in 155 minutes. Law Officer and Rajbhasha Adhikari have a similar structure but include General Awareness with Special Reference to Banking Industry in place of Quantitative Aptitude.

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in objective tests; no penalty applies for unattempted questions.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying for IBPS CRP SPL-XVI

Many candidates lose their chance at IBPS Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 due to avoidable errors during the application process. Being aware of these common mistakes in advance can help ensure a smooth, error-free submission.

NaBFID Business Analyst Eligibility Criteria 2026

Educational Qualification

The candidate should have cleared the final CA exam as on the cut-off date of 30 June 2026. Only candidates who have registered themselves on the ICAI Placement Portal (icaiplacements.icai.org) as newly qualified Chartered Accountants are eligible.

Reservation-Related Eligibility Notes

  • SC/ST candidates must submit a Caste Certificate issued by a Competent Authority in the Government of India prescribed format, whenever required by the Bank.
  • OBC reservation is available only to 'Non-Creamy Layer' OBC candidates, as governed by Office Memorandum No. 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.1993. 'Creamy layer' OBC candidates must indicate their category as 'General'. The OBC certificate must be in the Government of India prescribed format with the 'Non-creamy layer' clause, issued between 01.04.2026 and the date of interview.
  • EWS reservation is governed by Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31.01.2019. EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further Government of India directives and the outcome of any litigation. EWS candidates must produce an Income & Asset Certificate based on gross annual income for FY 2025-26, valid for 2026-27.
  • Reserved-category candidates for whom no reservation has been mentioned in a particular stream are free to apply under the General category, provided they meet all General category eligibility conditions.
  • There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in the Officers' Cadre.
  • No change in category is permitted after registration of the online application; no correspondence, email, or phone call will be entertained regarding category change.

PwBD Eligibility

Horizontal reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as per Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act (RPwD), 2016. The identified categories for this recruitment are Visual Impairment (VI) and Hearing Impaired (HI):

  • Visual Impairment: Includes blindness (total absence of sight, or visual acuity less than 3/60 in the better eye, or field of vision limited to less than 10 degrees) and low vision (visual acuity not exceeding 6/18 up to 3/60, or field of vision limited to less than 40 degrees up to 10 degrees) after best correction.
  • Hearing Impaired: Hard of Hearing means 60 dB to 70 dB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears.

PwBD candidates must produce a certificate issued by a Competent Authority as per Government of India guidelines. Disability conditions classified as "likely to improve" under a temporary category are not eligible for reservation; conditions that are progressive, non-progressive, or not likely to improve are treated as eligible.

NaBFID Business Analyst Job Profile (Stream-wise)

Lending Operations (Lending & Project Finance)

  • Credit appraisal and financial analysis of lending proposals, including financial statements, business models, cash flow projections, sponsor strength, project risk, security structure, and repayment capacity.
  • Validation of project financial models against the Techno-Economic Viability (TEV) report, industry benchmarks, and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordination on loan documentation, verification of sanction terms and Conditions Precedent (CPs), and initiation of disbursement.
  • ESG monitoring, tracking Early Warning Signals (EWS), and periodic asset quality review.
  • Credit monitoring and portfolio management, including covenant compliance and risk mitigation recommendations.

Investment & Treasury

  • Settlement and accounting of treasury trades, reconciliation and balancing of books, and valuation of securities.
  • Timely submission of regulatory statements, audit reports, and MIS.
  • Exposure to finance and treasury activities including banking, cash and liquidity management, and capital and debt markets.

Accounts

  • Support the Bank's financial reporting, financial planning, and analysis in line with statutory standards.
  • Preparation and analysis of financial statements and management information for strategic decision-making.
  • Financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and performance monitoring.
  • Engagement with auditors, tax authorities, and regulators on financial reporting, accounting, and taxation matters.

Risk Management

  • Credit risk assessment of new proposals in line with existing policies and SOPs.
  • Periodic review of the existing portfolio, including internal credit ratings and rating rationale.
  • Monitoring of regulatory and management exposure limits at account and group level.
  • Assistance in determining provisioning requirements and developing/testing internal credit rating models.

Internal Audit

  • Planning, executing, and reporting on Risk Based Internal Audit covering business operations, infrastructure lending/project finance, and support functions.
  • Evaluating internal controls, governance mechanisms, and risk management processes in line with RBI and NaBFID policies.
  • Process walkthroughs, control testing, and preparation of audit reports with findings and recommendations.
  • Support for the Annual Audit Plan and follow-up reviews for audit compliance.

Compliance

  • Design and strengthening of the Bank's Compliance Governance Framework in line with the NaBFID Act and RBI guidelines.
  • Preparing compliance reports, dashboards, and updates for the Board, Audit Committee, and other Board-level committees.
  • Monitoring regulatory circulars and notifications from RBI, FIU-IND, SEBI, CBDT, IRDAI, MCA, and international bodies.
  • Advisory support on AML/CFT, KYC/CDD, sanctions compliance, and beneficial ownership requirements.

Across all streams, candidates should possess excellent communication skills and proficiency in the use of computers and information technology.

NaBFID Business Analyst Selection Process

  • Selection is entirely through a Personal Interview.
  • NaBFID will shortlist candidates for interview from newly qualified Chartered Accountants registered on the ICAI Placement Portal.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in a ratio of 5 to 15 times the position-wise vacancies, as decided by the Bank.
  • Interviews will be conducted only at the Mumbai Centre of ICAI.
  • Total marks for the interview: 100.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: not less than 40% for GEN/EWS candidates, and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates.
  • The Bank reserves the right to waive or modify the minimum qualifying marks at any stage, without prior intimation.

NaBFID Business Analyst Required Documents

  • Caste Certificate (for SC/ST candidates), in the Government of India prescribed format.
  • OBC Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (for OBC candidates), issued between 01.04.2026 and the date of interview.
  • Income & Asset Certificate for FY 2025-26 (for EWS candidates), valid for 2026-27.
  • PwBD certificate issued by a Competent Authority, as per Government of India guidelines (for PwBD candidates).
  • Relieving letter/discharge certificate in original, for candidates already in service, at the time of joining.
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer, for candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government offices, PSUs, Nationalized Banks, and Financial Institutions, at the time of interview.

How to Apply for NaBFID Business Analyst Recruitment 2026

  1. Register as a newly qualified Chartered Accountant on the ICAI Placement Portal at https://icaiplacements.icai.org.
  2. Regularly check the careers section of the Bank's website, nabfid.org/careers, for updates related to this recruitment.
  3. NaBFID will shortlist candidates directly from the ICAI Placement Portal registrations for the personal interview.
  4. Attend the interview at the Mumbai Centre of ICAI on the notified date, carrying all required original certificates and documents.

Important: No other means or mode of application will be entertained. Hard copies of the application and other documents should not be sent to NaBFID's office. Any application sent directly to NaBFID will not be entertained under any circumstances.

RBI Site Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Eligibility for RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 is reckoned as on 01 June 2026 and includes nationality, age, educational qualification, and work experience requirements specific to each post. All three posts require a B.Tech (or equivalent) in the relevant stream along with extensive government-sector construction experience.

Post Essential Qualification Essential Work Experience
Consultant Site Engineer (Civil) Level 2 B.Tech or equivalent in Civil stream Min. 15 years in construction & project management of buildings, incl. 5 years in CPWD/CPSU/similar govt. org. not below Assistant Executive Engineer rank
Consultant Site Engineer (Civil) Level 3 B.Tech or equivalent in Civil stream Min. 15 years in construction & project management, incl. 5 years in CPWD/CPSU/similar govt. org. not below Executive Engineer rank

RBI Site Engineer Application Fee 2026

The application fee for RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 varies by category, with SC/ST/PwBD candidates paying a lower intimation charge compared to General, OBC, and EWS candidates. RBI staff candidates meeting specific eligibility criteria are exempted from the fee entirely.

Bank and transaction charges are borne separately by the candidate, and the fee can be paid online via debit card, credit card, internet banking, IMPS, or mobile wallets. Once paid, the application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances and cannot be carried forward to a future selection process.

RBI Site Engineer Selection Process 2026

Candidates wondering about the RBI Site Engineer selection process can note that there is no written exam for this recruitment. Selection happens through preliminary screening by a Screening Committee, followed by document verification and a personal interview.

Step-by-Step Selection Methodology

  • Screening & Shortlisting: The Screening Committee may enhance minimum qualification or experience criteria to limit the number of candidates called, in proportion to the number of vacancies. Merely meeting minimum eligibility does not guarantee an interview call.
  • Interview Call Letter: Shortlisted candidates receive their call letter only via email from [email protected] — no postal call letters are issued.
  • Document Verification: Candidates must produce up-to-date Experience Certificates clearly stating nature of duties, dates, duration, level/position, and responsibilities, along with category, age, and qualification proofs.
  • Interview: Candidates discuss their anticipated compensation (within the advertised range) along with previous employer compensation details before the interview, which is considered by the Selection Committee.
  • Final Selection: The RBI Services Board's decision on eligibility, shortlisting, and interview results is final and binding, with no further correspondence entertained.

How to Apply for RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 (Apply Online)

Candidates can apply for RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 only through the official website www.rbi.org.in between 29 June 2026 and 20 July 2026. The process requires registration, document upload, a live photograph capture, and online fee payment before final submission.

  1. Visit www.rbi.org.in, go to Opportunities@RBI > Current Vacancies > Vacancies, and select "Lateral Recruitment of Site Engineers on Full-Time Contract Basis in RBI."
  2. Click "Online Application Form" and select "Click here for New Registration"; enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Log in and fill in personal, educational, and experience details, using "Save and Next" to verify entries before final submission.
  4. Upload your scanned photograph (20-50KB, JPG), signature (10-20KB, JPG), left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Capture and upload a live photograph using a webcam or mobile phone QR scan during registration.
  6. Upload supporting PDF documents (20KB-500KB each) for age, category, educational qualification, and work experience proof.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after verifying all details, since no changes are allowed afterward.
  8. Proceed to the "Payment" tab and pay the applicable fee via debit card, credit card, net banking, IMPS, or mobile wallet, then click "Submit."

Candidates should submit only one application per post; in case of multiple submissions, only the last completed application with the higher Registration ID (RID) will be considered, and fees paid against one RID cannot be adjusted to another.

RBI Site Engineer Salary and Pay Scale 2026

Selected candidates under RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 receive a monthly consolidated compensation based on their post level, along with housing allowance applicable at the centre of posting. The Selection Committee can offer a higher starting amount within a defined range based on the candidate's qualification, experience, and skill set.

Level Standard Monthly Compensation Negotiable Range
Level 2 (Grade B) ₹2,40,000 ₹2,40,000 to ₹3,40,000
Level 3 (Grade C) ₹3,10,000 ₹3,10,000 to ₹4,10,000

The monthly compensation, excluding housing allowance, increases by 7% on successful completion of every 12 months during the contract period, including any extension. This compensation is subject to applicable tax deduction at source, and contract appointees are not eligible for superannuation, separation benefits, or any other allowance or medical benefit beyond what is specified.

RBI Site Engineer Contract Terms 2026

The RBI Site Engineer posts are offered on a full-time contract basis with an initial tenure of three years, extendable by mutual agreement for up to two more years based on performance. Candidates should understand these terms clearly before applying, since the role differs significantly from a regular RBI employment position.

Term Details
Type of Appointment Full-time contract basis

Notice Period 1 month (first year), 3 months (after first year)
Leave 30 days per calendar year, credited half-yearly

RBI Site Engineer Document Requirements 2026

Candidates applying for RBI Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 must upload several documents in PDF format during the online application process, with each clearly supporting their claims for age, category, qualification, and experience. Missing or unclear documents can lead to rejection at the verification stage.

  • Proof of age (PDF format)
  • Category certificate for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS, where applicable, dated on or before the closing date
  • Educational qualification documents (B.Tech/M.Tech certificates and mark sheets)
  • Up-to-date Experience Certificate clearly stating nature of duties, dates, duration, level/position, and responsibilities
  • Scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20-50KB, JPG/JPEG)
  • Scanned signature in black ink (10-20KB, JPG/JPEG)
  • Left thumb impression (20-50KB) and handwritten declaration in English (50-100KB)
  • Live photograph captured via webcam or mobile during registration

OBC candidates must specifically produce a Non-Creamy Layer certificate based on income for FY 2023-24, 2024-25, or 2025-26, issued on or after 01 April 2026 but before the closing date of 20 July 2026.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying for RBI Site Engineer 2026

Many candidates risk rejection due to avoidable errors during the RBI Site Engineer online application process. Reviewing these common mistakes beforehand can help ensure your application is processed without issues.

  • Writing the declaration in capital letters or another language: The handwritten declaration must be in English, in the candidate's own handwriting, and not in capital letters — non-compliant declarations make the application invalid.
  • Expecting age relaxation: Unlike many government recruitments, RBI has explicitly stated no age relaxation is available for any category in this notification, so candidates must meet the 40-65 year window strictly.
  • Submitting multiple incomplete applications: If multiple applications are filed for the same post, only the last completed one with the higher Registration ID is considered, and the fee from the earlier RID is not adjusted.
  • Uploading documents in the wrong format: Photograph and signature must be JPG/JPEG, while all other supporting documents must be in PDF format within the specified size limits.
  • Not informing current employer: Government/PSU employees must submit an undertaking confirming they have informed their employer in writing about applying, or their candidature may be rejected.
  • Ignoring OBC NCL certificate dating: OBC candidates need a Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01 April 2026 — older certificates based on different financial years won't be accepted.

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) conducts the recruitment exam for the post of Section Controller, and candidates preparing for it must have complete clarity on the RRB Section Controller Syllabus 2026 and exam pattern before starting their preparation. The selection process tests candidates on analytical ability, logical reasoning, and mental aptitude through two computer-based stages. This article covers the subject-wise syllabus, stage-wise exam pattern, marking scheme, selection process, and preparation tips based on the official RRB Section Controller notification.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

RRB Section Controller Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026 - Overview

Before going through the detailed syllabus, candidates should check the key highlights of the RRB Section Controller exam in the table below.

Particulars Details
Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)
Post Name Section Controller (SC)
Selection Stages CBT, CBAT, Document Verification
Total Questions (CBT) 100 (Objective Type)
Total Marks (CBT) 100
Duration (CBT) 120 minutes
Negative Marking (CBT) 1/3 mark deducted per wrong answer
Negative Marking (CBAT) None
Final Merit Weightage 70% CBT + 30% CBAT
Official Website rrbapply.gov.in

RRB Section Controller Selection Process 2026

Candidates applying for the Section Controller post go through a three-stage selection process. Each stage acts as a shortlisting filter for the next, and only candidates who clear one stage are called for the following one.

  1. Computer-Based Test (CBT): The first and screening stage, conducted in an objective MCQ format covering Analytical & Mathematical Capability, Logical Capability, and Mental Reasoning.
  2. Computer-Based Aptitude Test (CBAT): Candidates shortlisted from the CBT, generally in a ratio of 8 times the number of vacancies, appear for the CBAT, which evaluates psychometric and aptitude parameters through multiple test batteries.
  3. Document Verification (DV): Candidates who qualify both CBT and CBAT and are shortlisted on the final merit list must appear for document verification with their original certificates.

The final merit list is prepared using a combined weightage of 70% from the CBT score and 30% from the CBAT score. Only candidates who qualify the CBAT are considered for the final merit list.

Also Read: RRB Section Controller Recruitment 2026 (CEN 03/2026): 119 Vacancies

RRB Section Controller Exam Pattern 2026

The exam pattern has two distinct computer-based stages the CBT and the CBAT each with its own structure, marking rules, and qualifying criteria. Understanding both separately helps candidates plan their preparation and expectations correctly.

RRB Section Controller CBT Exam Pattern

The CBT is an objective-type test consisting of 100 questions to be attempted in 120 minutes. It is divided into three sections as shown below.

Subject No. of Questions Marks Duration
Analytical & Mathematical Capability 60 60 120 minutes
Logical Capability 20 20
Mental Reasoning 20 20
Total 100 100

Key highlights of the CBT:

  • Mode of exam: Computer-Based Test (CBT)
  • Type of questions: Multiple Choice (Objective)
  • Total questions: 100
  • Duration: 120 minutes
  • Negative marking: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer

RRB Section Controller CBAT Exam Pattern

The Computer-Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) is conducted for candidates shortlisted from the CBT, usually in a ratio of eight times the total vacancies. It is held in both English and Hindi and consists of multiple aptitude test batteries.

Particulars Details Remarks
Shortlisting for CBAT 8 times the number of vacancies from CBT Applies to all categories (UR, OBC-NCL, SC, ST, EWS, ExSM)
Test Language English & Hindi Questions available in both languages
Qualifying Marks Minimum T-score of 42 in each test battery No relaxation for any category
Mandatory Requirement Vision Certificate (Annexure VI) in original during CBAT Candidates cannot appear without it
Negative Marking None Qualifying in every test battery is still compulsory
Final Merit Weightage 70% CBT + 30% CBAT Only CBAT-qualified candidates are considered

RRB Section Controller Syllabus 2026

The RRB Section Controller syllabus is divided into three core sections, each testing a different skill set. Below is the subject-wise and topic-wise breakdown as per the official pattern.

1. Analytical and Mathematical Capability

(A) Mathematics

  • Percentages
  • Profit, Loss & Discounts
  • Number System
  • Ratio & Proportions
  • Averages
  • Time, Speed, Distance
  • Power & Work
  • Algebra, Linear Equations
  • Arithmetic Progression
  • LCM, HCF
  • Geometry, Area & Volumes
  • Probability (Basic Level)
  • Statistics (Basic Level)

(B) Data Analysis & Interpretation

  • Graphical data charts, graphs, scatter plots, pie charts, statistical curve distribution, Venn diagrams
  • Multi-source data analysis reading and drawing inferences from text and tabular data
  • Data Sufficiency
  • Data Arrangement

2. Logical Capability

(A) Logical Reasoning

  • Binary Logic
  • Logic-based puzzles
  • Syllogism
  • Clocks & Calendars
  • Assumptions
  • Relations, Family Tree

(B) Reading Comprehension

Passages may be drawn from areas such as history, society, literature, science, environment, mythology, technology, and culture. Questions are typically framed around:

  • Main idea of the passage
  • Supporting idea
  • Application-based questions
  • Logical structure of the passage
  • Style/tone of the given paragraph

3. Mental Reasoning

  • Analogy identifying relationships between two items and applying them to another pair
  • Series Completion identifying number/letter patterns and predicting the next term
  • Coding-Decoding type questions
  • Ranking and Arrangement-based problems

How to Prepare for RRB Section Controller Exam 2026

  1. Go through the RRB Section Controller syllabus and exam pattern thoroughly first, and mark out the high-weightage topics from Mathematics and Reasoning before starting preparation.
  2. Create a daily study timetable that splits time across Analytical & Mathematical Capability, Logical Capability, and Mental Reasoning rather than focusing on only one section.
  3. Solve previous year question papers regularly to understand the difficulty level and question pattern of the CBT.
  4. Take full-length mock tests under timed conditions to build speed and accuracy for the 120-minute, 100-question format.
  5. After every mock test, review your mistakes and give extra revision time to the weak topics identified.
  6. Since CBAT tests aptitude and psychometric traits rather than static knowledge, practise sample aptitude test batteries in advance to get familiar with the format and timing.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Musician Intake Bharti 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Passed Matriculation / 10th or equivalent with minimum pass marks from any Govt. recognized School / Board.
  • Music Ability – 
  1. Candidates must have proficiency in music with accuracy in tempo, pitch and singing one complete song. They should be able to perform one preparatory tune and any of the notations i.e. Staff notation/ Tablature/ Tonic Solfa/ Hindustani/ Carnatic etc. Candidates must be able to tune individual instruments (in case of instruments require tuning) and match unknown notes on vocal or instruments.

  • Musical Experience Certificate –

  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Musician Intake Online Form 2026 : Physical Eligibility Details

  • Height –
  1. For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
  2. For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
  • Weight – Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
  • Chest –
  • For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
  • For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
  1. Hearing – Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
  2. Dental – Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
  • Visual Standards – 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D, Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
  • Physical Fitness Test (PFT) – PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes (For Female Candidates).
  • Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) & 10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).

Post Name Qualification
Primary Teacher
  • Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed./BTC). OR
  • Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed./BTC) obtained in accordance with the NCTE (Recognition, Norms and Procedure) Regulations, 2002. OR

  • Regularly appointed Assistant Teachers/Head Teachers (Primary) and Assistant Teachers/Head Teachers (Upper Primary) serving in all categories of schools allotted a DISE Code and teaching Classes 1 to 5 (in-service teachers).
Upper Primary Teacher
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) along with a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (BTC/D.El.Ed.). OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 1-year Bachelor of Education (B.Ed./L.T./Shiksha Shastri) (Regular/Institutional only). OR

  • Senior Secondary (10+2) or its equivalent with at least 50% marks and a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.). OR
  • Senior Secondary (10+2) or its equivalent with at least 50% marks and a 4-year B.A. B.Ed. / B.Sc. B.Ed. integrated degree. OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a B.Ed. (Special Education) recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). OR
  • Graduation or Post-Graduation with at least 50% marks and B.Ed. However, the minimum percentage requirement at the graduation level shall not apply to candidates who were admitted to the B.Ed., Bachelor of Elementary Education, or equivalent teacher education programme before 29 July 2011. OR
  • In-Service Teachers: Regularly appointed Assistant Teachers, Head Teachers, and Assistant Teachers (L.T.) serving in schools having a DISE Code and teaching Classes VI to VIII (6 to 8) are also eligible.

How to Calculate Your Expected CBT-2 Score

  1. Download the official RRB JE CBT-2 Answer Key 2026.
  2. Compare each of your responses with the correct answer shown in the key.
  3. Award 1 mark for every correct answer.
  4. Deduct 1/3 mark for every incorrect answer.
  5. Add up the marks to arrive at your total probable score.

Formula: Expected Score = Correct Answers - (Wrong Answers × 1/3)

For example, if a candidate has 120 correct answers and 15 wrong answers:
Expected Score = 120 - (15 × 1/3) = 115 marks

  • Gives candidates an early sense of cut-off trends and their relative performance.

Once the objection window closes on 17 July 2026, the Railway Recruitment Board will follow this process:

  • Objections found valid will be accepted and the answer key will be revised accordingly.
  • A final answer key will be released on the official website. The exact date for this is not mentioned in the official notification.

OSSSC CRE Prelims Marking Scheme 2026

Before calculating a probable score from the answer key, it helps to know exactly how marks are awarded and deducted in the OSSSC CRE Prelims exam.

Formula to calculate score:

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Look for the notification related to the Tier 2 scorecard and final answer key for CGL 2025-26.
  3. Click on the candidate login link provided in the notification.
  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

Handle branch management operations including teller functions, customer service, and daily reporting. 2. Cater to customer needs at the welcome desk and teller counter with a service-to-sales mindset. 3. Understand customer needs and offer relevant banking solutions, savings accounts, deposits, loans, insurance, and investment products. 4. Cross-sell and upsell banking products including third-party products (insurance, mutual funds). 5. Ensure compliance with KYC, AML, and all HDFC Bank policies and regulations. 6. Manage customer onboarding for new-to-bank customers within defined turnaround times. 7. Use banking software (FlexCube) for transaction processing and customer data management. 8. Candidates complete intensive classroom training at NIIT affiliated campuses, receive a Certificate in ACE Banker Program from NIIT IFBI, and are directly placed at an HDFC Bank branch after clearing training with minimum 60% marks. This person is a highly creative content creator who thrives in fast-paced digital environments and has a passion for social media, video storytelling, and audience engagement.   • Supports the development and execution of integrated marketing and advocacy campaigns designed to grow audiences, increase engagement, inspire action, and strengthen supporter relationships

  • Uses analytics and audience insights to evaluate content performance, identify opportunities for growth, and optimize digital strategies across platforms

  • Thrives in fast-paced digital environments, brings curiosity and creativity to content development, and continuously tests new approaches to audience engagement and storytelling

  • Has an energized curiosity for emerging trends in digital spaces (including new platforms, influencers, media focuses, and cultural movements) that are related or tangential to PPGNY’s missions and values

  • Ability to identify opportunities for digital content and spearhead creative

Role Snapshot
Position Summary

The Director, Army Sales is a senior player/coach sales leader responsible for driving personal sales performance while guiding and enabling a team of field sales managers and representatives. This role maintains direct customer engagement and may carry a personal or shared sales target, while providing leadership across territory strategy, pipeline development, and sales execution.

The Director shares accountability for field sales performance within the service vertical, operating in close partnership with the VP, Business Unit Leader, who retains ultimate ownership of revenue outcomes and business performance. Success in this role is measured by Individual and shared revenue contribution, overall field sales execution effectiveness, pipeline health and opportunity progression, team development, coaching impact, and retention, and alignment with business unit sales strategy

Essential Functions

Reasonable Accommodations Statement

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the essential duties outlined below. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Essential Functions Statements

Sales Performance & Territory Execution

  • Contribute directly to revenue generation while supporting and influencing overall field sales performance across the service vertical
  • Partner with the VP, Business Unit Leader to execute sales strategy, territory coverage models, and performance priorities
  • Support sales managers and representatives through coaching, deal strategy, and escalation support, while reinforcing accountability and execution discipline
  • Develop and execute territory and account plans aligned to company objectives
  • Maintain and manage an active pipeline of opportunities, quotes, and orders
  • Drive opportunity progression from identification through order execution

Customer & Account Management

  • Maintain direct customer relationships and participate personally in key deals, strategic accounts, and complex sales efforts as both a seller and leader
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with end users, contracting offices, and program stakeholders
  • Conduct regular in-person customer visits, briefings, and solution discussions
  • Identify customer requirements and translate needs into product and service solutions
  • Serve as the primary field point of contact for assigned accounts

Market, Program & Budget Awareness

  • Maintain working knowledge of DoD budget cycles, appropriations, and funding mechanisms as they impact customer buying behavior
  • Monitor customer programs, funding timelines, and mission priorities
  • Liaise with strategy, business development, and capture teams to align field sales activity with longer-term pursuits

Team and Cross Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with inside sales, contracts, pricing, and operations teams to support order fulfillment and customer satisfaction
  • Coordinate vendor relationships, ride-alongs, and product demonstrations
  • Communicate competitive intelligence, market trends, and customer feedback to leadership
  • Serve as a player/coach by mentoring and supporting Field Sales Representatives, providing guidance on account strategy, customer engagement, and opportunity progression without serving as the sole owner of team outcomes

Reporting & Systems

  • Maintain accurate CRM (Salesforce) records, forecasts, and pipeline reporting
  • Prepare sales reports, expense reports, and required administrative documentation

Additional Duties

  • Interface and effectively communicate with the management team, staff, customers, sub-contractors, vendors, business partners, and suppliers
  • Take ownership and responsibility for all aspects of the customer and team sales process
  • Maintain and update a Google calendar consisting of client calls, travel, and working sales pipeline

Requirements

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • 10+ years of experience leading field sales teams in DoD or federal markets
  • Demonstrated success coaching quota-carrying sales teams to revenue targets
  • Strong knowledge of Navy and Marine Corps procurement environments
  • Strong understanding of federal procurement, contracting, and customer environments
  • Prior military service strongly preferred
  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent industry experience
  • U.S. citizenship and eligibility to work in the United States required. This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance

Computer Skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Google Office Suite
  • Experience using Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting accuracy
  • Proficiency with internet research and searching
  • NetSuite or familiarity with an ERP system a plus

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Personal at-home office for administrative duties required

Job description:

This is a six-week residency programme, not salaried employment. Read on for what it actually offers.


About Saff

Saff is a six-week residency for Muslim founders who have already shipped. You move into one house in London with nine other founders, build a go-to-market system around your company, and close with a demo day where half the room are buyers.


What you walk out with

  • A mapped list of your hundred target accounts and thirty dream buyers, built in week one
  • A live pipeline: buyer meetings engineered during the season, not after it
  • Residency fully covered: travel, stay, food, production
  • Mentors in residence, plus visiting operators and angels, weekly angel dinners
  • Capital: a flexible offer within guardrails, Â£20k to Â£100k, structured around your stage
  • London demo day with investors and buyers who watched you build
  • A personal episode arc and a lifetime seat in the Saff alumni row


Who we're looking for

  • Already building: you've shipped a product with real users or early revenue, no ideas on paper
  • Able to commit: you can live and build in residence in London for the full six weeks
  • Muslim founders building across the UK, Europe, or North America, solo or co-founded
  • You know your buyer: you can name the five customers that would change your company, and we'll help you reach them


Positive action statement

Saff runs under the positive action provisions of the Equality Act 2010 (Section 158), in response to documented underrepresentation of Muslim founders in UK venture capital: 3% of UK venture deals go to a Muslim founder against 5â7% of the population (source: proprietary analysis of 953 deals across the UK's top 20 venture funds). This programme is a proportionate measure addressing that disadvantage and is open to Muslim founders building across the UK, Europe, and North America.

Requirements

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Take shifts of full responsibility for monitoring the plant operations as necessary and directed.

  • Replace consumable products such as filter elements and chemicals.
  • Take company provided training courses in environmental health and safety and comply with safe working practices.
  • Work on various projects to keep the plant neat, clean and safe. These include but are not limited to removing corrosion, brushing, sweeping, sanding, painting, tightening, landscaping and other types of manual and semi-skilled labor.
  • Engage in preventive maintenance as directed.
  • Engage in corrective maintenance and repair as directed; inclusive of, but not limited to, mechanical or electrical.
  • Engage in equipment service and repair as directed.
  • Keep track of inventory by marking down or reporting to the Plant Manager any items used or items that the company is low on in order to ensure that adequate spare parts, consumables lubricants etc. are kept on site in adequate supply.
  • Be positive, pleasant to co-workers and customer service oriented and to the extent that there is normal contact with the customer. Report any customer feedback, good or bad.

Role Snapshot
Intro

The organisation has reached an important inflection point. It has built a proven product, established strong market traction, and is entering its next phase of growth. The challenge is no longer proving the model. The challenge is scaling it without compromising quality.

That is what this role is for.

We are looking for a Product Director who thrives on building operational systems that enable exceptional products to scale. This is not a traditional product management role. It is a leadership opportunity for someone who thinks in systems, has exceptionally high standards, moves with pace, and sees AI as fundamental to how modern organisations should operate.

Role Overview

Reporting directly to senior leadership, the Product Director will lead the Product Development function responsible for the operational product layer supporting a rapidly growing programme portfolio.

You will transform strategic vision into scalable operating models, build the infrastructure that enables sustainable growth, and ensure products continue to improve as the organisation expands. Your work will directly influence quality, execution speed, commercial performance, and the overall customer experience.

This is a leadership role with line management responsibility for Product Development team members while working closely alongside peers responsible for learner delivery, commercial operations, technology, marketing, and partner success.

Why This Opportunity?

Few organisations reach the point where the product works, demand is growing rapidly, and the next challenge becomes building the operational engine capable of supporting the next stage of expansion.

This organisation is there now.

The ambition is significant. Growth is planned and measurable. Success will depend on creating systems that allow more products to launch, more efficiently, while continually raising quality rather than compromising it.

This role exists because operational excellence is becoming one of the organisation's greatest competitive advantages.

If you enjoy solving difficult operational problems, building for scale rather than today's requirements, and creating systems that enable people to do their best work, this is an opportunity to have genuine organisational impact.

What You'll Own

  • The operational infrastructure supporting programme development, launch and continuous improvement
  • Product quality across the customer journey, ensuring every improvement raises standards rather than simply increasing speed
  • Operational systems, tooling and AI enabled workflows that improve efficiency and scalability
  • Launch readiness by reducing friction, increasing repeatability and improving execution without sacrificing quality
  • Cross functional operating rhythms that align Product, Technology, Delivery, Commercial and Marketing teams
  • Operational reporting, KPIs and decision making frameworks that support continuous improvement
  • Prioritisation and execution across multiple initiatives, ensuring strategic objectives are translated into delivery
  • Building scalable operating models capable of supporting significant future growth
  • Developing and leading the Product Development team while coaching individuals and creating a culture of continuous improvement

What You Won't Own

  • Strategic business direction, which is established by senior leadership
  • Learner facing delivery operations, which are led by a dedicated Learner Delivery Director
  • Academic content, curriculum design or subject matter expertise
  • Instead, your role is to ensure the operational systems supporting these functions are world class, scalable and continuously improving

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 30 days

  • Develop a deep understanding of how programmes currently operate and where operational friction exists
  • Build strong working relationships across leadership and key cross functional teams
  • Identify the highest leverage opportunities to improve quality, efficiency and scalability
  • Understand how AI is currently being used and where it can create significantly greater value
  • Develop an informed perspective on what excellent operational product delivery should look like

Within your first 90 days

  • Lead operational improvements that measurably improve launch readiness and execution
  • Introduce scalable operating practices that improve consistency across programmes
  • Present a prioritised roadmap for product operations, tooling and AI integration
  • Become the trusted operational leader colleagues turn to when complex challenges arise
  • Within your first 180 days
  • Operational performance is improving across measurable KPIs
  • Launches become faster, more repeatable and more predictable
  • AI is embedded meaningfully into operational workflows rather than used as a standalone tool
  • The Product Development function is enabling the organisation to scale confidently without compromising quality
  • Senior leadership spends significantly less time resolving operational issues and more time focusing on strategic growth

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

  • You have successfully built products, operational systems or platforms within fast growing organisations
  • You naturally think several stages ahead and build for future scale rather than today's requirements
  • You combine strategic thinking with exceptional operational execution
  • You have a strong product mindset and care deeply about customer outcomes and quality
  • You are highly AI fluent and already use modern AI tools daily to improve decision making, productivity and innovation
  • You understand that operational excellence exists to accelerate commercial growth, not create unnecessary process
  • You communicate clearly, make decisions confidently and influence across functions without relying on hierarchy
  • You enjoy working in ambitious, fast moving environments where expectations are high and bureaucracy is low
  • Experience within digital learning, SaaS, technology, marketplaces or another rapidly scaling environment would be advantageous but is not essential

This Role Is Not

  • This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured, consensus driven organisations where change happens slowly
  • It is not focused on curriculum design, academic leadership or learner delivery
  • It is not a large people management position. Success comes from influencing across functions, improving systems and enabling others to perform at their best
  • If you are excited by solving operational complexity, challenging conventional approaches, embracing AI, and continuously raising standards, this role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a lasting impact

Benefits

  • Collaborative, people centred performance culture
  • Opportunity to shape a high growth product function during a pivotal stage of organisational growth
  • Flexible remote working within UK hours with international collaboration
  • Professional development within an ambitious, fast paced environment

Our Recruitment Process

We run a fast, transparent recruitment process designed to help both you and us determine whether this is the right opportunity. We value your time and aim to keep every stage purposeful, engaging and efficient.

  • Application Review Every application is reviewed by our recruitment team and hiring stakeholders
  • Introductory Conversation A 30 minute conversation to discuss the opportunity, your experience, and mutual fit
  • Leadership Interview A 60 minute interview with senior leadership, exploring your experience, approach, and how you would contribute to the organisation's growth
  • Cross Functional Interview A 60 minute discussion with key stakeholders from across the organisation to explore collaboration, leadership style, and problem solving
  • Practical Assessment A focused take home exercise designed to reflect the challenges of the role. We ask candidates to allow approximately 2 to 3 hours to complete the assessment
  • Final Conversation and Offer A final discussion with senior leadership followed by an offer for the successful candidate

Throughout every stage, we believe in clear communication, timely feedback, and a professional candidate experience.

This is a pivotal executive leadership role for an experienced Chief Operating Officer who combines strong operational leadership with deep regulatory awareness. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and holding the SMF24 Chief Operations Function under the Senior Managers & Certification Regime (SM&CR), the COO will play a central role in shaping the organisation's operational strategy, resilience and long-term success.

 

As a member of the Executive Committee, the COO will influence key business decisions, drive operational excellence and ensure the organisation remains resilient, scalable and well-positioned for future growth. Working closely with the Board, regulators and senior stakeholders, the successful individual will help foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement and collaborative leadership across the business.

 

This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact, leading critical operations, sponsoring transformation initiatives and ensuring the organisation delivers exceptional service while maintaining the highest standards of governance and regulatory compliance.

 

Skills / Knowledge Required

 

Â·        Extensive senior leadership experience in banking operations within a UK-regulated financial institution.

Â·        Deep understanding of PRA/FCA regulatory frameworks, including SM&CR, operational resilience requirements, outsourcing rules and conduct expectations.

Â·        Demonstrable experience performing or directly supporting an SMF24 role.

Â·        Strong expertise in operational resilience, business continuity, crisis management and end-to-end operational process oversight.

Â·        Proven experience managing an Operational Middle Office.

Â·        Strong track record of involvement in IT projects, technology-enabled change and operational transformation.

Â·        Proven ability to manage operational risk within the first line of defence.

Â·        Strong governance and committee experience with Board-level influence.

Â·        Excellent leadership skills and ability to drive cultural change.

Â·        Strong analytical, strategic planning and problem-solving capabilities.

Â·        Exceptional communication skills and ability to engage with regulators and senior stakeholders.

 

Job role

 

Regulatory Leadership (SMF24)

 

As the approved holder of the SMF24 Chief Operations Function, you will:

Fulfil all SMF24 responsibilities in line with PRA and FCA requirements and expectations.

Ensure the organisation's operational framework remains robust, well-controlled and aligned with regulatory standards.

Promote and uphold the principles of the Senior Manager Conduct Rules across the operational environment.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with regulatory stakeholders.

 

Operational Leadership & Oversight

 

You will provide strategic leadership across the operational landscape, ensuring that processes, controls and capabilities support the organisation's ambitions.

Responsibilities include:

Maintaining oversight of core operational processes, systems and controls across the business.

Ensuring operational activities are efficient, scalable and aligned with the firm's risk appetite.

Driving operational effectiveness through ongoing improvement, innovation and simplification.

Providing leadership and oversight of the Operational Middle Office and associated operational functions.

 

Operational Resilience

 

Operational resilience sits at the heart of this role.

 

You will:

Lead and continually enhance the firm's Operational Resilience Framework.

Oversee the identification and management of Important Business Services (IBS) and associated impact tolerances.

Ensure the business can continue to deliver critical services during severe but plausible disruption scenarios.

Sponsor scenario testing, operational mapping and remediation programmes.

Maintain oversight of business continuity planning, crisis management and disaster recovery capabilities.

Deliver meaningful insight and reporting to Executive and Board-level stakeholders.

 

Governance & Executive Leadership

 

As a key member of the Executive Committee, you will help shape the organisation's strategic direction while ensuring strong governance remains embedded throughout the business.

You will:

Contribute to strategic planning, risk management and executive decision-making.

Provide clear and insightful reporting to the Board and Board Committees.

Champion a culture of accountability, transparency and operational excellence.

Support the business in balancing commercial objectives with regulatory expectations.


Outsourcing & Third-Party Oversight

 

You will ensure the organisation derives maximum value from its third-party partnerships while maintaining appropriate oversight and control.

This includes:

Overseeing outsourced services and key third-party relationships.

Monitoring service performance, resilience and regulatory compliance.

Ensuring outsourcing arrangements remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements and business needs.

Identifying and mitigating risks arising from external dependencies.

 

Change, Transformation & Technology

 

The COO will act as a senior sponsor for strategic change initiatives that enhance operational capability and support the organisation's growth ambitions.

You will:

Lead and sponsor technology-enabled transformation programmes.

Ensure operational readiness for new platforms, systems and business capabilities.

Partner closely with technology teams and key stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.

Balance innovation with operational stability, resilience and risk management.

Ensure change activity strengthens rather than compromises the firm's control environment.

 

Leadership & Culture

 

A key part of the role will be building high-performing teams and creating an environment where people can thrive.

You will:

Lead, mentor and develop leaders across the COO function.

Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Champion high standards of conduct, risk awareness and customer focus.

Ensure the function is appropriately resourced, skilled and positioned to support future growth.

Inspire teams to deliver operational excellence while embracing change and innovation.

 

What Success Looks Like

 

The successful COO will be a visible and influential leader who combines strategic vision with operational discipline. They will create an environment where strong governance, operational excellence and commercial growth work hand in hand, ensuring the organisation remains resilient, well-controlled and positioned for long-term success.
